title: Certification Architect
description:
About the Team

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

About the Role

As Certification Architect, you will define the framework, standards, and assessment architecture that make OpenAI certifications a trusted signal of demonstrated capability.

This is a senior hands-on role on the Certification team that will build reusable foundations for a growing portfolio: clear competency standards, defensible assessments, scalable in-product delivery, and evidence of continued competence.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep certification and assessment expertise with the ability to innovate new and meaningful ways to demonstrate practical AI competence. You will work closely with certification specialists, technical subject matter experts, learning product and engineering teams, operations and policy partners, and stakeholders across the go-to-market organization.

The program is early, and you will help shape how people demonstrate capability in ChatGPT and Codex. Success means building standards that are rigorous, usable, and adaptable as AI technology and professional roles evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the credential framework and shared competency standards, distinguishing completed learning, demonstrated skills, and formal certification, with clear capability claims and evidence requirements for each.

  • Establish reusable assessment standards and guidance for certification pods across job-task analysis, competency models, assessment blueprints, performance tasks, scoring rubrics, and passing standards.

  • Own the validation approach and evidence documentation requirements. Partner with pod leaders to validate certification proposals against job relevance, representative task coverage, scoring consistency, fairness, and appropriate interpretation of results.

  • Define exam delivery architecture and requirements with product, engineering, operations, and third parties, spanning registration, identity verification, monitoring, permitted assistance, evidence capture, scoring, human review, appeals, customer support, and record management.

  • Define expectations for continued competence validation post-assessment.

  • Partner with learning, operations, policy, legal, privacy, security, and accessibility teams to align preparation with competencies while protecting assessment integrity and establishing appropriate evidence access, retention, accommodations, and review processes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years experience designing and delivering professional technical IT industry certifications or assessments that support credible claims about what people can do.

  • Have led design of performance-based assessments for AI, software development, technical architecture, or customer-facing implementation roles.

  • Have built credential frameworks, competency models, or shared assessment standards that work across multiple roles or programs.

  • Have led job-task analysis, assessment blueprints, performance-based assessment, rubric design, standard setting, and the evidence needed to support valid and fair certification decisions.

  • Can translate assessment experience requirements into exam delivery specifications for third parties and learning product teams.

  • Have worked closely with certification specialists, psychometricians and subject matter experts to validate assessment and scoring standards and improve assessment quality.

  • Communicate complex standards clearly to technical and nontechnical partners, and build alignment across teams without relying on formal authority.

  • Enjoy hands-on work, from drafting standards and reviewing assessment designs to resolving practical delivery tradeoffs with a small team.

  • Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments, balancing rigor, candidate experience, delivery feasibility, and the pace of technology change.

  • Care deeply about accessibility, fairness, and the integrity of credentials that individuals and employers rely on.

  • Build reusable approaches while recognizing where different roles need distinct competency models, tasks, and evidence.

Additional experience that would be helpful includes:

  • Validating AI-assisted scoring, model evaluations, or other automated approaches to evaluating human performance.

  • Working with secure assessment delivery, identity verification, credential issuance, learner records, or assessment technology providers.

  • Developing innovative approaches to recertification, ongoing competence, or assessment of authentic work.

  • Building products that serve both individual users and organizations.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

title: Architect
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team

About the job

Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3-5 years are the right ones.

You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy-by-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own the architecture and multi-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them.
  • Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build-versus-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints.
  • Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy.
  • Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt.
  • Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right-to-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems.
  • Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use.
  • Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed-systems and performance problems.
  • Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad.
  • Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re-sequence when the tradeoffs require it.
  • Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming-first architectures, federated query, and AI-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role.
  • Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm.
  • Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake and lakehouse architecture, partitioning, indexing, query planning, and how the choices affect cost and performance at petabyte scale.
  • Breadth across data storage and retrieval technologies, with hands-on depth in at least two of: analytical/OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse), search engines (e.g., ElasticSearch/OpenSearch), and lake or distributed processing engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink). You can reason about when to use each, how they interoperate, and how to migrate between them.
  • Working knowledge of streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) and how they interact with downstream storage.
  • Practical experience designing data governance at scale: data classification, catalog and metadata management, lineage, and access control integrated with authentication and authorization systems.
  • Practical experience implementing privacy and compliance requirements (deletion, retention, residency) across a large, heterogeneous data estate.
  • Proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, and Go.
  • Track record of writing and driving architecture decisions across multiple teams, and of changing the direction of an organization’s technical roadmap through influence rather than authority.
  • Experience elevating engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers across teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence: architecting for high availability, observability and incident response in distributed systems, and being credible when a platform is failing in production.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including making a complex tradeoff clear to engineers and to senior leadership.

Desired:

  • Experience operating one of these engines (e.g., ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) at scale, including replication, sharding, ingestion behavior, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Experience with catalog and metadata systems (e.g., Unity Catalog, Glue, Polaris, DataHub) and open table format catalog strategy.
  • Experience with a platform migration across domains or ownership models, such as moving from central to domain-owned data.
  • A track record of measurable cost optimization on large data platforms.
  • Networking and network security knowledge.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in the United States.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $207,200 - $233,100.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $219,360 - $246,780.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $243,680 - $274,140.

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 1/4/2027 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Manager, Enterprise Sales - Hedge Funds
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the leader of our new Hedge Funds sales team within Enterprise FSI, you will build and lead the team that brings transformational AI to the world’s leading hedge funds - multi-strategy platforms, quantitative and systematic firms, discretionary long/short equity, global macro, and credit funds. These are some of the most technically sophisticated and competitive organizations in financial services, rethinking how they generate ideas, conduct research, build and test strategies, manage risk, and run their operations - and they’re looking for a partner they trust to take frontier AI from promising experiments into production at the research, engineering, and operations levels.

You’ll own a focused portfolio of top-tier funds at very different stages of AI adoption, from firms already running Claude across research and engineering to those just beginning their journey. You will lead Enterprise and Strategic Account Executives, design the coverage and territory model, and build the repeatable, hedge-fund-specific plays that turn early wins into durable, scaled adoption. The selling is technical and multi-stakeholder - platform decisions, protection of proprietary strategies and data, security and compliance rigor, and solutions built on Claude through our API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and partner cloud platforms. Lead and scale - as you’ll shape strategy and operating rhythm while staying personally engaged with founders, CIOs, CTOs, and heads of research on the pursuits that matter most.

This is a rare opportunity to build a team from the ground up, not just run a number: to shape how the hedge fund industry adopts frontier AI, and to do it at a company where safety, trust, and long-term customer outcomes are central to how we sell.

Key responsibilities:

  • Define Hedge Fund go-to-market strategy and coverage design, including segmentation, territories, account prioritization, and vertical value propositions, and evolve the coverage model as the business scales

  • Recruit, coach, and retain Enterprise & Strategic Account Executives with deep financial-services and platform-selling expertise; develop talent and create career paths that keep top performers growing

  • Build repeatable eval, deployment, and adoption practices while partnering with Marketing, Enablement, and partner teams to scale them

  • Engage personally with C-level executives on priority pursuits, building business cases and value narratives and navigating complex procurement, security, and legal processes through to production deployment and expansion

  • Own the team’s revenue targets and operating rhythm, instilling pipeline-generation discipline and running forecasting, deal inspection, and account planning cadences that make performance predictable and coachable across a high-volume book of business

  • Partner closely with Applied AI, Solutions Architecture, and Product to design solutions, prove value quickly, and represent client requirements on security, deployment, and performance to Product

  • Orchestrate cross-functional and partner motions with Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, and cloud partners to deliver a seamless customer experience, and represent Anthropic with customers and at industry events as a visible, trusted leader

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience leading enterprise sales teams that sell technical, complex products such as API-first platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data and machine learning platforms into hedge funds

  • A track record of winning and growing enterprise customers, including building C-suite relationships, in hedge funds

  • Experience designing go-to-market coverage for an enterprise sales team, including segmentation, territories, and account prioritization

  • Operational rigor across both a high-volume pipeline and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, balancing velocity with deal quality and forecasting accurately in fast-changing environments

  • Credibility with technical buyers and builders — CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Heads of Research — and experience pairing effectively with solutions architects and applied AI teams

  • Strong coaching skills that raise team performance through deal coaching and account strategy, combined with personal effectiveness alongside executives on high-priority opportunities

  • Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based commercial models and value-based pricing conversations

  • A genuine interest in deploying AI responsibly and motivation to advance Anthropic’s mission of building safe, beneficial AI

Preferred qualifications:

  • Second-line management experience or demonstrated readiness to step into that scope

  • Experience bringing generative AI or LLM-based products, or other emerging platform technologies, to hedge funds

  • Deep familiarity with regulated-industry selling — model-risk management, regulatory and compliance-driven procurement, security review, and the governance expectations of financial institutions

  • Experience selling with IP protection, security, and vendor risk in mind

  • Experience leading organizations through rapid growth, re-segmentation, or significant change

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$450,000—$700,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Product Designer (Identity UX).

About the job

At Twilio, we’re building the identity layer for both people and the AI agents acting on their behalf. We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer (L4) to define the user experience for Twilio Identity: customer identity (authentication, Hosted Login, and user management) and Agent Identity, which lets developers open their apps and APIs, including remote MCP servers, to AI agents with user consent, scoped access, and human approval for sensitive actions over Twilio channels like SMS and RCS.

You’ll be the lead designer on a small, senior team, working with product and engineering from the first sketch. You’ll own the developer setup experience in One Console, the login and consent flows our customers put in front of their users, and the patterns that make security decisions easy to understand without slowing anyone down. Agent Identity is in private beta and heads to general availability at SIGNAL 2027, so this is a chance to define the core UX of a new product category.

Responsibilities

  • Own Identity UX End to End: Lead the experience for developer onboarding and configuration in One Console, Hosted Login, and end-user authentication flows.
  • Design for Agents and the People Behind Them: Define how AI agents are registered, how users grant and revoke consent, how permissions are scoped, and how users approve sensitive agent actions in real time.
  • Make Self-Serve Fast: Shorten the path from sign-up to a working integration, so developers can evaluate and adopt Twilio Identity without talking to sales.
  • Translate Protocol Complexity: Turn OAuth, tokens, scopes, and approval flows into clear mental models for developers and plain-language choices for end users.
  • Partner Before the PRD: Work with PM and engineering from problem framing through launch, co-owning scope and tradeoffs while holding a high bar for craft.
  • Talk to Customers Directly: Run research and usability testing with design partners and developers, and ground decisions in what you learn.
  • Raise the Bar: Contribute to Twilio’s design system and UX design feedback process, and mentor other designers.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Work schedule: Full-time, US-based, remote.
  • 8+ years of professional product design experience specifically focused on highly technical software products, developer tools, infrastructure, or complex B2B/SaaS platforms.
  • Expert-Level Systems Thinking: Track record designing complex, configuration-heavy products (developer consoles, admin tools, or multi-step setup flows) and unifying them into coherent experiences.
  • Executive Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven success partnering directly with engineering and product leaders (Director/VP level) to navigate organizational complexity, align cross-product touchpoints, and shape multi-year product roadmaps.
  • Comfort with Ambiguity: A self-starter who thrives when thrown into highly complex, loosely-defined technical spaces and is capable of building clear frameworks out of abstract constraints.
  • Designing for Trust and Control: Experience designing permission, consent, approval, or similarly high-stakes flows where users need to understand and control what a system can do on their behalf.

Desired:

  • Design for Developers: Practical experience designing interfaces for technical builders (APIs, SDKs, CLIs, and configuration consoles).
  • Identity & Security Experience: Familiarity with authentication and authorization products (OAuth/OIDC, SSO, MFA, passkeys, CIAM).
  • AI Agent Experience: Experience designing for AI agents or LLM-based products, including human-in-the-loop controls.

Location

This role will be remote and based in the United States,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $141,520 – $176,900
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $149,840 – $187,300
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $166,400 – $208,000
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 11/25/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Product Designer, Physical Engineering
description:
About the Team

The Physical Engineering team sits within OpenAI’s Enterprise Verticals organization. We’re exploring how frontier AI can help people design, simulate, and build better physical products - shortening development cycles, improving product performance, and expanding what engineering teams can accomplish.

We’re building experiences within ChatGPT and integrations with tools such as CAD, eCAD, CAE, and simulation software to support engineers from early concepts through design, validation, and preparation for production.

We operate as a small founding team, working directly with customers and closely with research, product, data science, and forward-deployed engineering. We learn by building, putting products in users’ hands, and using their feedback to guide what comes next.

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly autonomous Product Designer to become the first dedicated designer on the Physical Engineering team. You’ll help define this product area from its earliest stages - shaping what we build, how it works, and how design operates within the team.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for someone with a founder’s mindset. You’ll work deeply with engineers and customers to understand complex technical workflows, identify valuable opportunities, and turn emerging AI capabilities into intuitive, trustworthy products. You’ll move between product strategy, interaction design, prototyping, research, and detailed execution, often making decisions with incomplete information.

While your initial focus may be Physical Engineering, your work could extend across Enterprise Verticals as the design function grows. You’ll help establish reusable patterns and a high bar for craft across specialized AI products.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Define the product and design vision for AI-powered physical-engineering experiences.

  • Lead design from customer discovery and early prototyping through detailed execution, launch, and iteration.

  • Create intuitive interfaces that help engineers understand, inspect, and refine complex designs, simulations, and model outputs.

  • Work directly with mechanical, electrical, and other physical engineers to understand their tools, constraints, and workflows.

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, research, data science, and forward-deployed teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical products.

  • Prototype new interaction models for visual, spatial, and technically complex work.

  • Balance speed and exploration with a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, reliability, and user trust.

  • Establish foundational design patterns and practices that can scale across Physical Engineering and other enterprise verticals.

  • Operate independently, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and bring clarity to an exceptionally early and ambiguous product space.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have independently led substantial zero-to-one products from early exploration through launch.

  • Bring exceptional product judgment, interaction design, and visual craft to complex professional software.

  • Are highly autonomous and comfortable defining both the problem and the path forward.

  • Think and operate like a founder: learning quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and remaining accountable for outcomes.

  • Enjoy working directly with highly technical users and translating specialized workflows into clear product experiences.

  • Can move fluidly between long-term vision, systems thinking, rapid prototyping, and detailed execution.

  • Build alignment through compelling prototypes, clear narratives, and close cross-functional collaboration.

  • Are energized by unfamiliar domains and can develop enough technical depth to make thoughtful design decisions.

  • Want to help establish the design culture and foundations of a new team.

Particularly relevant experience includes:

  • Designing CAD, CAE, eCAD, simulation, chip-design, manufacturing, or other engineering software.

  • Building interactive tools for visual, spatial, data-intensive, or technically complex workflows.

  • Designing professional or enterprise products that integrate with established tools and systems.

  • Working as a founding designer, early startup designer, or first designer within a new product area.

title: Member of Technical Staff, ML Platform (Evals)
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

We're looking for an ML infrastructure engineer to own model evaluation at Runway, end to end. Every decision we make about a model – which checkpoint to keep training, what to ship to millions of users, which datamix and architecture shows the most promise – rests on evals. Today that work is spread across the organization. You'll turn it into one platform.

Your job will be to design and build the systems that generate samples at scale, score them with automated metrics and human annotations, track results across checkpoints and releases, and put the answers in front of researchers in minutes rather than days. You'll define what "better" means operationally – how we measure it, how confident we are, and how a result becomes a ship/no-ship decision.

You'll be embedded within research teams as a member of ML Platform, and you'll set the technical direction for evals across the company. This is an extremely high-leverage role: the quality of our models is bounded by how well we can measure them.

A peek at our technical stack

Our inference and training code is written in Python (PyTorch) and is cloud-native. We leverage multiple clouds and use a combination of Kubernetes native and home-grown tooling for efficient job orchestration.

We’re big users of agentic development and operations. We have a robust internal platform and provide broad access to the latest models and harnesses.

You’ll have access to best-in-class models, agents, GPUs, storage and cloud services you need to drive a world class evaluation pipeline that helps us deliver frontier models.

What you'll do

  • Own the evaluation platform end to end: the tooling and systems required to generate, annotate, review and adapt at frontier scale

  • Define the CLIs, APIs, GUIs and storage layers required to make this process seamless, fast, sophisticated and collaborative

  • Work directly with research teams on video, image, audio, agents, and robotics to understand what they need to measure and build it, then generalize the result into the platform

  • Help set the standards for how we evaluate models at Runway: reproducibility, metric definitions, reporting formats, and when a result is trustworthy enough to act on

  • Support broad adoption of the platform and its integration throughout Runway’s research efforts across training, production model serving and more

  • Contribute broadly as a member of the ML Platform team to tools and systems that help Runway train and serve frontier models

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience building ML infrastructure or data platforms in production environments, with at least some of that time spent on evaluation, experimentation, or benchmarking systems

  • Strong Python and PyTorch, and hands-on experience running large batch GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Experience designing data pipelines and storage for large volumes of media or model outputs, with attention to versioning and reproducibility

  • Familiarity with experimental statistics: paired comparisons, confidence intervals, multiple-comparison pitfalls, inter-rater agreement

  • Comfort building internal tools end to end, from the command line to the browser

  • Ability to lead a broad technical area: gather requirements from many teams, set direction, make tradeoffs, and drive a roadmap without waiting to be told

  • Familiarity with the full model development lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, serving

  • Self-starter who can work embedded with research teams and move fast

  • Strong systems thinking and pragmatic approach to production reliability

  • Humility and open mindedness; at Runway we love to learn from one another

Nice to have

  • Track record of building evaluation suites for generative models

  • Hands-on work with LLM- or VLM-as-judge pipelines

  • Experience with online experimentation platforms and connecting offline metrics to product outcomes

  • Prior work evaluating agents or robotics policies

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

title: Scaled Customer Engagement Manager (9-month contract)
description:
Scaled Customer Engagement (SCE) is a small, high-impact team within Digital Customer Success that delivers one-to-many engagements for PointClickCare customers across all our market segments in Senior Care and Acute & Payer. The team works both remotely and in a hybrid model, partnering closely with CSMs, Marketing, Product, and Support. SCE owns programs such as the Customer Success Monthly Digests, Digital Customer Success Reviews, and Gainsight Journey Orchestrator and Pendo Orchestrate programs (for adoption, retention, and CSM-led events), giving every customer—not only the largest—a consistent, data-informed path to value. Working on our team provides a unique opportunity to help build a scaled CS motion, including automation and AI, at one of healthcare's leading platforms.
The Scaled Customer Engagement Manager drives adoption, retention, and value realization for a large customer base through scalable, data-informed, one-to-many programs. Applying solid knowledge of PCC solutions and the industry, the SCE Manager customizes established strategies into digital journeys, communications, and events, and partners cross-functionally to execute them. The role exists so that every PointClickCare customer receives proactive, consistent engagement—extending the reach of the CSM team and contributing to NRR and controllable-churn goals.
Work Location:Remote or hybrid, with periodic in-person collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Deliver scaled programs end to end: Owns the build and delivery of assigned digital programs (e.g., segment-specific Customer Success Monthly Digests, onboarding/adoption journeys, renewal, risk-mitigation campaigns, and Digital Customer Success Reviews) using Gainsight Journey Orchestrator and Pendo Orchestrate; adapts content to customer segment, maturity, and use case.
  2. Use data to target and optimize: Analyzes usage, health, and engagement data to identify trends or red flags; uses segmentation and automation to trigger the right engagement at the right time; A/B tests and adjusts content; builds custom dashboards to track program KPIs.
  3. Engage customers one-to-many: Helps plan and present digital customer events (user groups, webinars, office hours, and training sessions); creates and maintains digital content (articles, guides, videos) that explains core workflows and solution value in customer terms.
  4. Collaborate cross-functionally and advocate for customers: Coordinates with CSMs, Marketing, Product, Support, and Sales to align messaging and timing; shares customer feedback and themes back to Product and Marketing; documents program objectives, outcomes, and next steps.
  5. Continuous improvement: Experiments with new approaches on a small scale (including AI-assisted content and personalization), shares results with the team, and recommends better practices or tools that streamline workflows.

Minimum

  1. 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Marketing, Customer Education, or a related customer-facing SaaS role
  2. Experience designing or executing one-to-many programs (email campaigns, webinars, in-app messaging, or community)
  3. Strong written communication; able to tailor messages to different audiences and roles
  4. Working proficiency with CRM / CS platforms (Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar) and Excel-based data analysis
  5. Ability to interpret product usage and engagement data to drive action
  6. Strong organization and project management across multiple concurrent programs and deadlines
  7. Excellent presentation skills

Preferred

  1. Hands-on experience with Gainsight Journey Orchestrator, Pendo Orchestrate, or similar digital engagement tools
  2. Experience in healthcare technology, post-acute, senior living, or acute/payer markets
  3. Experience using AI tools to personalize communications and scale engagement
  4. Basic HTML/email-builder or design skills

title: AirCover Specialist, Claims Experience
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Description

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb's various functions embody the company's innovative spirit, and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The AirCover team is charged with ideating, building, launching, and managing the AirCover business inside of Airbnb. We have a huge responsibility to our community of Hosts and Guests to be there when things don’t go exactly as planned with their reservations. We have a lot of work to do in the coming years and we are looking for someone who will help us manage all of the things that need to be done to deliver best-in-class services to our community.

The Claims Experience team is responsible for providing premium support for our users by tailoring the experience and services we offer to their own specific needs so that everyone can host and travel with confidence. We develop a deep empathy and understanding of each of our customer’s desires, and go above and beyond to create personalized interactions that leave lasting impressions throughout the end-to-end claims process.

The team drives operational success across each of the Aircover products, delivering Seamless Execution through the quality and speed of our interactions, whilst focusing on customer retention and the continued growth of our Airbnb community.

About you

  • You are passionate about delivering exceptional and tailored experiences for our customers, anticipating their needs and understanding what great looks like for the user experience
  • You are someone who thrives in taking initiative in a fast-moving environment, bringing a growth mindset and bias toward execution.
  • You foster strong customer relationships by actively engaging with users and identifying opportunities to enhance the service experience
  • You are knowledgeable and experienced in the end to end claims process and take full ownership for reaching a complete final resolution with care and attention
  • You identify gaps in workflow, process or policy whilst striving to provide upward feedback as required

How you’ll make an impact

  • You will be responsible for understanding the unique needs of our customers and go above and beyond to create personalized interactions that leave a lasting impression throughout the end-to-end claims process.
  • You will treat customers with consistency, fairness and empathy so that they feel heard and understood, and will tailor the support provided to their specific needs to resolve issues efficiently and to a high level of mutual satisfaction.
  • By enhancing the customer experience from end to end you will help drive retention rates and ensure that everyone can travel and host on Airbnb with confidence.

In this role you’ll get to

  • Evaluate, investigate and resolve claims submitted across our Aircover products (including but not limited to Host Damage Protection claims) including claims of high value and complexity that require complex investigation and negotiations to reach satisfactory outcomes
  • Closely monitor for fraud detection and mitigate risks associated with bad actors to protect the Airbnb brand and community
  • Verify all relevant facts and evidence to determine case resolution outcomes whilst following internal policies and workflows
  • Go above and beyond to create personalized interactions and exceptional premium support throughout the end-to-end claims process, tailoring the experience offered whilst ensuring each user’s needs and preferences are met with the highest level of care and attention
  • Provide continuous education and guidance for users about our Aircover products, terms and policies to enable the seamless resolution of their requests
  • Work closely with stakeholders and third party claims administrators to align on case strategies and ensure a timely resolution is reached for our users
  • Communicate regularly with Supervisors and Manager to provide feedback on the status of claims
  • Maintain high levels of confidentiality whilst conducting investigations
  • Identify gaps in workflow, process or policy whilst striving to provide upward feedback as required to further improve the experience for our customers
  • Act as subject matter expert for change initiatives and/or cross functional projects taking place across the Aircover Scaled Ops and Optimization org, including assisting internal stakeholders to test, refine, ideate, and deploy new internal products and processes
  • Support the training and mentoring of new hires throughout the onboarding process
  • Support existing team members by sharing best practices, providing technical expertise on case consults, approvals and escalations in order to help improve overall performance of the team

We are looking for people who have

  • 5+ years in a fintech or customer experience role , with a minimum of 1+ years experience handling insurance claims, preferably including first and third party property damage claims
  • Critical thinking skills with a proven track record in solving challenging customer problems and making claims decisions with consistency and fairness whilst adhering to policy terms and workflows
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with customers through multiple channels including email, messaging and phone
  • Active listening skills to understand user needs and provide personalized recommendations and assistance
  • Ability to explain complex and sensitive issues to customers with confidence and clarity
  • Analytical skills with the ability to organize and work independently with rapidly changing priorities
  • Negotiation skills to ensure customer issues are resolved in a timely and efficient manner
  • Solution and outcome-oriented with an ability to balance fraud prevention alongside a positive user experience
  • Calm and Empathetic with ability to adapt to any situation by personalizing responses and educating our community whilst remaining level headed in challenging situations
  • A regular work schedule of 5 days per week (40 hours), mutually agreed with your Supervisor, which may include weekend days and company wide / public holidays

Preferred experience

  • Experience working on change initiatives and/or cross-functional projects to meet strategic goals.
  • Experience working with internal stakeholders and third party administrators to resolve complex claims in a detailed, effective and timely manner.
  • Proficiency in English and Japanese language.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Global Initiatives Curator
description:

The Community You Will Join:

The Offline Design team shapes what makes an Airbnb Experience worth traveling for. Our Curation team sets and upholds the quality bar for Experiences globally, translating taste into repeatable systems that scale across markets. This role reports to the Director of Experience Design and partners closely with Supply Acquisition, Product Marketing, Market Management, Demand, Growth Marketing, Research, and Enterprise Operations to strategize and bring Experiences to life around the world.

The Difference You Will Make:

As the Global Initiatives Curator, you will lead new, first-of-their-kind initiatives that scale the Curation team's impact in step with the needs of the Experiences business. You will solve complex, cross-functional problems, then brief the Curation team on how to action the solutions globally and at scale. Success looks like a unified quality bar across markets, a clear architecture for the types of Experiences we offer, new markets launched with consistent processes, and AI-enabled tools that make the team's taste repeatable at scale.

A Typical Day:

  • Store design & quality: Maintain the quality bar of sourced Experiences globally, and unify the quality of co-designed Experiences with the Supply Acquisition team across regions.
  • Market launches & experiences strategy: Support new market launches with unified processes, identify supply categories based on demand, store performance, and external signals, and surface strategic differentiation bets across global markets.
  • Experiences architecture & storytelling: Define the architecture and criteria for types of Experiences. Craft the narrative for new supply types to leadership, and cascade it to internal teams.
  • Scale learnings globally: Identify new experiences opportunities to prototype based on regional observations, spot strengths in individual markets, and scale those learnings to others.
  • Build with AI: Partner with Research and Enterprise Operations to build AI tools that unify the Curation team's processes and codify taste at scale.

Curate the highest-quality, most differentiated supply into collections for Airbnb launch moments and advise on merchandising to maximize both direct bookings and brand recognition.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Enterprise Operations organization is instrumental in powering Airbnb's growth and expansion at a global scale. Through AI- and people-powered operations, this team maximizes the effectiveness, utilization, and impact of our supply, ensuring hosts and guests can seamlessly connect.

The Supply Enablement & Activation team is a horizontal Center of Excellence within Enterprise Operations, serving as a strategic partner to global field and vendor teams by driving standardized strategy, tools, and best practices at scale. We turn our supply strategy into repeatable, scalable, best in class enablement deliverables – collateral, training, tools & workflows, and comms/change management -- for our sales & operator teams across each line of business: Homes, Hotels, Experiences & Services.

This role supports the API team, which sits at the heart of Airbnb's Supply strategy, managing the connectivity partners — property management software providers, channel managers, and distribution platforms — that power a significant share of our global inventory. These partnerships unlock access to millions of listings and directly shape the quality and reliability of the host and guest experience.

At the center of this work are our Connectivity Partner Managers, who own Airbnb's relationships with these third-party technology providers — PMS (Property Management System), channel manager, and revenue management tool vendors that hosts and property managers use to sync listings, calendars, pricing, and reservations with Airbnb. Connectivity Partner Managers are the primary point of contact for these partners: they ensure integrations meet Airbnb's connectivity standards, resolve sync and data issues, onboard new partners, negotiate partnership terms, drive adoption of Airbnb's APIs among software vendors, and work with Product and Engineering to prioritize roadmap improvements based on partner feedback.

We're looking for a seasoned Senior Enablement Manager to build and own end-to-end enablement for Airbnb's API team and Connectivity Partner Managers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. This is a newly approved, full-time role created to close a resourcing gap: enablement support for API has historically been covered informally and part-time, and this role will stand up a sustainable, scalable enablement function from the ground up.

Connectivity Partner Managers own the full relationship with PMS, channel manager, and revenue management tool partners — from onboarding and integration standards to sync/data issue resolution, contract negotiation, API adoption, and roadmap prioritization with Product and Engineering. You will own onboarding, training, and continuous development for teams supporting API partners; drive consistent acquisition, growth, and retention of high-quality supply; and localize global enablement programs for regional relevance. You'll partner cross-functionally to collect and share feedback, and use enablement tools and insights to continuously improve outcomes.

  • Experience creating and delivering agile, AI-powered enablement content — narratives, sales pitches, talking points, objection handling, and standardized playbooks — preferably in the hospitality, travel, or tech industry
  • Experience with API ecosystems, connectivity partnerships, or two-sided marketplace dynamics
  • Comfort operating in a technical, product-driven environment; ability to engage credibly with Product roadmaps and connectivity/API partner managers

region: California, United States, Oregon, United States, Washington, United States
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb’s various functions embody the company’s innovative spirit, and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The Content & Knowledge Management (CKM) team that you would join makes accurate and authoritative information available at scale by creating, editing, and managing metadata and support content—including the public Help Center and internal knowledge bases—used by customers, CS agents, and consuming applications, including AI chatbots.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge Architecture will help establish and evolve the emerging discipline of content engineering—designing, structuring, delivering, and managing content so it’s strategic, scalable, consumable across surfaces, and efficiently adjusted, rather than a collection of one-off articles or chunks—within our organization.

In this leadership role, you'll own CKM inputs and influence infrastructure that construct and ingest an information layer, which serves various audiences and product surfaces. You will own decisions that determine how knowledge is created, updated, architected, organized, stored, retrieved, and surfaced. You'll also steer the cross-functional coordination that keeps CKM content aligned with product launches and other business developments or needs.

You’ll lead the teams who run taxonomy and ontology, content tooling and AI-focused optimization, as well as content operations planning. You’ll be accountable for how well they perform together: setting direction, clarifying who owns what, and developing the leaders and teams who make it work.

We seek someone who sees how systems underneath our content — taxonomy, tooling, authoring processes, information architecture, and operational planning — increasingly determine whether that content reaches the people and machines that need it. You should understand how user-facing content, metadata, measurement and authoring systems, and consuming applications all depend on each other, and you can spot where inconsistency in one area will eventually break something in another. Most importantly, you should view these as a cohesive unit, not several separate functions that happen to share a roof.

A Typical Day:

  • Define and champion the evolving discipline of content engineering within CKM, establishing standards for how knowledge is structured, stored, and delivered across surfaces and applications.
  • Own the roadmap for metadata, taxonomy, and information architecture that determines how content is organized, discovered, and reused.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define and prioritize tooling investment that improves content quality, efficiency, and innovation.
  • Establish governance frameworks that embed standards and quality checks directly into content creation, review, and publishing workflows.
  • Define the metrics and reporting that give leadership visibility into content health, coverage, and performance, as well as authoring efficiency.
  • Steer cross-functional coordination that keeps CKM content aligned with product launches and other business needs.

  • Own talent decisions for the group, including hiring, calibration, promotion, and succession planning, applying clear leveling criteria so people are developed and recognized fairly.
  • Define roles and ownership across taxonomy and ontology, tooling and AI-focused optimization, and content operations planning, so everyone in the group knows what they own, what they influence, and where work hands off.
  • Set priorities and allocate resources and capacity across the group’s programs and roadmap.
  • Coach managers on team design and career development for their own teams, and help senior team members grow toward their next role. Sponsor a diverse group of talent and model Airbnb’s belonging behaviors.
  • Build strategic relationships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Design, among others, to ensure knowledge systems keep pace with company-wide priorities.
  • Champion a culture of technical and data fluency, editorial and operational excellence, and continuous improvement across a diverse team.

Your Expertise:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in content strategy, content operations, or knowledge management, including substantial experience with content systems, taxonomy, and/or information architecture at scale.
  • 5+ years of managing managers, with a track record of developing high-performing, distributed teams, and steering them toward a shared strategy and standard.
  • Hands-on experience owning talent decisions, including hiring, performance management, calibration, and succession planning.
  • Experience in customer support, contact center operations, or a similar global service organization is a plus.

  • Deep expertise in content strategy, knowledge management, and information architecture, with a demonstrated understanding of AI/ML applications in content operations.
  • Expert knowledge of content management systems and authoring tooling; practical experience with AI-powered content optimization.
  • Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on system architecture, data structures, and retrieval mechanics — deep technical fluency is essential.
  • Collaborative, solution-oriented, and able to execute at scale across genuinely distinct disciplines.
  • Highly developed executive presence, with the ability to build and present business cases to VP/C-level stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to steer and shape the work of multiple related teams and their leaders, removing ambiguity for executing parties and raising the capability of an already-strong team.

title: Senior Risk Tools & Automation Lead
description:
