About the Company

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to millions of hosts who have welcomed guests in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Payments Risk Operations team protects Airbnb's guests, hosts, and the platform from fraud, financial loss, and abuse. Our investigators and agents review high-risk activity every day, and the quality of their tools directly shapes the speed, accuracy, and consistency of every decision they make. You will join a team of operators, analysts, and program leaders who partner closely with Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to keep our community safe.

The Difference You Will Make

As the Senior Risk Tools & Automation Lead, you will own the end-to-end agent experience for risk and fraud operations. You will define what our investigators need, design and conceptualize the next generation of the risk workbench, and drive automation through process efficiencies and AI. You will be the voice of the agent in tooling decisions and the bridge between operational reality and technical execution. Your work will reduce manual effort, shorten handle times, improve decision quality, and free our experts to focus on the most complex cases.

A Typical Day

Agent experience

  • Own the end-to-end agent experience across risk and fraud investigation workflows, from case intake through decision, documentation, and quality review.
  • Spend time with agents to observe workflows, map pain points, and quantify friction in handle time, clicks, context switching, and error rates.
  • Establish feedback loops (surveys, office hours, champion networks, ticket intake) so agent needs are captured, prioritized, and closed out transparently.
  • Partner with Training, Quality, and Workforce Management to ensure tooling changes land with clear enablement, documentation, and adoption tracking.

Tooling requirements and improvements

  • Translate operational needs into clear, prioritized business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that Platform and Engineering can build against.
  • Own and manage the operational risk tooling roadmap and backlog, balancing quick wins, foundational investments, and policy or regulatory needs.
  • Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of tooling requests using impact sizing (time saved, loss prevented, accuracy gained, risk reduced).
  • Drive user acceptance testing (UAT), launch readiness, and post-launch measurement for every tooling release.

Workbench design and conceptualization

  • Define the long-term vision for a unified risk workbench that brings signals, account history, payment data, linked entities, and decisioning into a single, intuitive workspace.
  • Partner with Platform, Design, and UX Research to run discovery, build journey maps, create wireframes and prototypes, and conduct usability testing with agents.
  • Champion design principles of simplicity, consistency, and accessibility so agents can make accurate decisions quickly and confidently.

Automation through efficiencies and AI

  • Identify, size, and prioritize automation opportunities across manual and repetitive work, including case routing, data gathering, enrichment, summarization, and low-risk decisioning.
  • Partner with Platform, Engineering, and Data Science to design and deploy AI-assisted capabilities such as case summaries, recommended actions, agent copilots, and automated documentation.
  • Define human-in-the-loop guardrails, quality controls, and monitoring so automation improves efficiency without compromising accuracy, fairness, or compliance.
  • Build business cases that tie automation to measurable outcomes and report progress to senior leadership.

Cross-functional leadership

  • Serve as the primary operations policy partner to Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Policy, Legal, Compliance, and Finance on all risk tooling initiatives.
  • Influence without authority, align technical and non-technical stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and timelines.
  • Communicate roadmaps, launches, and impact clearly to audiences ranging from frontline agents to executive leadership.

Your Expertise

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in operations, program management, or product management.
  • 5+ years of experience in fraud, payment risk, trust and safety, or a related investigations industry.
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • Proven track record of writing successful business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that led to shipped tools with measurable impact.
  • Familiarity with user experience testing and design, including discovery interviews, journey mapping, usability testing, and working from wireframes or prototypes.
  • Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration with both technical partners (Engineering, Data Science, Platform) and non-technical partners (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance).
  • Experience identifying and delivering automation or process efficiency improvements at scale, with results tied to metrics such as handle time, throughput, accuracy, or loss.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to size opportunities, build business cases, and measure outcomes (SQL or similar skills a plus).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts for executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience designing or launching agent workbenches, case management systems, or investigation consoles.
  • Experience applying generative AI or large language models in operational settings, such as agent copilots, case summarization, or automated decision support.
  • Working knowledge of fraud and risk domains such as payment fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, identity verification, or AML.
  • Familiarity with workflow and automation platforms (for example, rules engines, RPA, or low-code tools) and with agile delivery practices.
  • Experience leading change management and driving adoption across large, globally distributed operations teams.
  • Experience working at an e-commerce, travel, fintech, or payments company.

description:

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb is a vision and mission driven company, and our Product Managers embody that mindset. Platform PMs imagine the ideal end state for our community first, work backwards from it, and deliver it in a scalable way. The AI Assistant team owns the agentic AI system that powers Airbnb's support experience for millions of guests and hosts. This is one of the highest-visibility applied-AI efforts at the company, and it sits at the intersection of large language models, platform thinking, and a genuinely two-sided marketplace.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will own the platform that determines how our AI Assistant reasons, retrieves, and responds: the layer that interprets each request and routes it, the knowledge and capabilities the assistant draws on, the actions it can take to actually resolve an issue, and the evaluation systems that keep it safe and accurate at scale.

You will own what a good outcome looks like for the user, and the criteria we measure it against, working through partners who own the underlying knowledge and the engineering implementation. This is a role where Product both directs technical work and does it themselves. You will diagnose architectural problems, author the artifacts that become production behavior, and help drive engineering and data science decisions alongside your key partners.

Support is high-stakes: people reach out when something has gone wrong, often with another party involved. You will be responsible for making those moments accurate, safe, and genuinely helpful, increasing how often the assistant fully and correctly resolves a request on its own while expanding coverage across more problem types and user touch points.

A Typical Day:

  • Set the product direction for how the assistant reasons and responds, and paint a multi-quarter vision with the customer at the center; align that vision with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Work fluently with production data. Explore the data directly, use modern AI tools and coding agents to move fast, validate an analysis, and dig in yourself to tell when a result doesn't look right.
  • Build new capabilities end to end, from spotting the need through the hands-on work that makes the behavior real and gets it calibrated with human input.
  • Decide what a correct, complete resolution looks like for each kind of user problem, and get engineering, policy, and knowledge partners aligned around that definition.
  • Define what success means in measurable terms: how often issues get fully resolved, how accurate and safe the answers are, and the bar that a change needs to clear in order to launch.
  • Own launch readiness for major model and platform changes, balancing speed to learn against the safety and risk work that has to happen before anything scales.
  • Diagnose why a complex AI system is failing, and judge where the fix actually belongs.
  • Own the evaluation strategy: LLM-based evaluators (LLM-as-judge), offline and live-traffic evaluation, calibration and certification, and the tooling that lets non-engineers safely improve the assistant.
  • Bring teams with different perspectives to a shared answer, set agreements with partners early, and push for a single source of truth across the product.
  • Present to leadership regularly, leading with the decision, the tradeoffs, and the ask, and tailoring the narrative to what the audience cares about.

Your Expertise:

  • 9+ years building technology products, with at least 5 in product management or a closely related technical role (engineering, data science, or applied research) from which you owned product direction.
  • Direct experience shipping generative AI or ML products to production, ideally including retrieval-augmented generation, agentic or function-calling architectures, and evaluation systems.
  • Hands-on technical depth. You read and debug prompts, understand ML and engineering constraints, and are comfortable personally authoring the artifacts that shape production behavior.
  • Data fluency. You can work directly with production data, validate an analysis end to end, and know when a result looks wrong, whether or not you write the query by hand.
  • Depth in LLM evaluation. You have designed, calibrated, or certified automated model-based evaluations, and can turn a vague quality signal into diagnostic, measurable components.
  • A strong sense for great user experience, including how latency, tone, and trust shape an AI interaction.
  • Comfort owning an ambiguous, cross-cutting mandate that spans several teams' focus areas, and the influence to drive alignment accordingly.
  • A track record of scaling your impact through others: setting a clear bar, assigning owners, and holding them to it.
  • Strong executive communication: can lead with the decision and the ask, and adjust the narrative to the audience.
  • Radical thinking paired with strong execution: can envision a system meaningfully better than today and articulate the path to get there.

title: Product Designer, International
region: Menlo Park, CA / New York, NY
salary: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC): $140,000 – $165,000 USD · Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL): $123,000 – $145,000 USD · Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL): $110,000 – $129,000 USD
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood's International team owns the full international product experience, bringing investing, trading, and crypto to customers in the EU, UK, Canada, Singapore, and beyond.

As a Product Designer, you'll help shape how customers around the world experience our products for the first time. You'll design onboarding, trading, and money movement experiences that hold up across currencies, languages, and regulatory environments, while staying true to the craft and clarity Robinhood is known for.

Design at Robinhood is AI-first. This role is for someone who already uses AI as a core part of how they think, explore, and execute.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Design key features such as onboarding, trading, crypto, and money movement for one or more of Robinhood's international markets.
  • Partner with product, engineering, legal, and compliance to navigate market-specific nuances without compromising a cohesive, high-quality experience.
  • Bring clarity to complexity by simplifying cross-border and multi-currency concepts into interfaces that feel simple and local.
  • Use AI to explore ideas, catch edge cases, and prototype quickly, while you drive the quality and direction.
  • Set direction and keep projects moving in markets with little existing precedent.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of product design experience and a strong portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of complex consumer products.
  • Regular use of AI in your design process.
  • Interest in global markets and cross-border financial products.
  • Experience working with legal, compliance, and cross-functional partners in a regulated environment.
  • Strong systems thinking, balancing consistency with Robinhood's core product against local market needs.
  • A bias for action: able to find the next step and move forward through ambiguity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Crypto Risk team's mission is to identify, assess, and mitigate risk across Robinhood Crypto's products, operations, and platforms, protecting customers and the firm as the business scales. We work to deliver an excellent end-customer experience while upholding the safety and soundness of the business, so Robinhood can keep expanding access to crypto responsibly. The team partners with engineering, product, compliance, crypto operations, and enterprise risk to keep a consistent view of risk across the organization. It's an exciting time to join as we launch new products and expand our crypto offering!

As a Risk Specialist, you will support the execution of our crypto risk management program, partnering closely with Crypto Risk leadership to monitor, assess, and report on risk across the business. You will play a hands-on role in building and running operational risk management, with a particular focus on technical and product risk. Day to day, you will assess new products and business changes for risk, run risk and control self-assessments, and prepare reporting for governance forums. You will translate technical risks into clear terms for colleagues outside engineering and work closely with partner teams across the business. Your work will help us keep pace with new launches while protecting customers and the firm!

This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Facilitate Technical Risk Assessments (TRAs) and product risk assessments for new and existing crypto products, features, and business changes: document and assess risks and controls in collaboration with engineering and product owners.
  • Analyze incident and issue data to identify recurring root causes, control weaknesses and systemic themes; lead or support retrospectives on material events and translate findings into actionable risk insights for leadership.
  • Mature the operational loss tracking process, including loss definitions, intake, taxonomy, linkage to incidents and issues, and trend reporting.
  • Manage the issue management lifecycle, from identification and prioritization through remediation tracking and closure, ensuring issues are handled and escalated appropriately.
  • Perform and refresh Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and support Business Impact Analyses.
  • Monitor, refine and develop key risk indicators (KRIs), and prepare risk reporting for governance forums, including risk committee and board materials and escalations.Translate technical risks into clear, actionable terms for non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Translate technical risks into clear, actionable terms for non-engineering partners.
  • Partner with engineering, product, compliance, crypto operations, and enterprise risk teams to maintain a consistent view of risk across the organization.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in operational risk, enterprise risk management, or technology risk at a regulated financial services or crypto/fintech firm. (US-based ERM experience is preferred).
  • Hands-on experience facilitating risk assessments (RCSA, technology or product risk assessments, process risk assessments), including working directly with business, product and engineering owners.
  • Experience designing, running or materially contributing to business continuity or disaster recovery exercises, including scenario design, facilitation and after action reporting.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis or thematic analysis across incidents, with the ability to identify patterns and systemic issues from operational data.
  • Deep understanding of risk management methodologies, including risk taxonomies, control design, KRIs and issue management.
  • Technical exposure and comfort working in a technical environment, with the ability to read engineering design documents and incident post mortems and extract the risk. A software engineering background is not required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and present risk findings to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Detail oriented, with a proactive, independent approach to identifying and addressing risk.

Bonus points

  • Direct experience in the cryptocurrency industry, with familiarity with crypto products, custody, and blockchain fundamentals.
  • A computer science or engineering degree, especially if you have built a career in risk, compliance, or another non-engineering role.
  • Experience building or operating an operational loss event program
  • Exposure to third party and vendor risk management, particularly for critical technology or custody providers.
  • Familiarity with operational resilience regulatory expectations such as NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500, DORA or MiCA.
  • Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools such as LogicGate or similar platforms.
  • Analytical background with knowledge of SQL, Python, or a BI tool.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$94,000—$110,000 USD
Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$82,000—$97,000 USD

$73,000—$86,000 USD

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

title: Product Designer - Figma Weave (Tel Aviv, Israel)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

Figma-Weave designers are highly collaborative self-starters who push their teams to build amazing experiences for all our users. We have a diverse range of experiences and expertise and love learning from each other. Our designers thrive on solving hard problems, considering every detail, and achieving ambitious goals.

We are looking for a Product Designer to join Figma Weave, this role sits at the intersection of generative AI, node-based workflow editing, and creative tools, building a platform that makes sophisticated AI generation accessible through visual workflows. You'll work directly with our founding team to drive critical initiatives - from our workflow editor, to team collaboration features, to strategic integrations with Figma. This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor where you'll have outsized impact on product direction and help define how creators interact with cutting-edge generative AI.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction
  • Help deliver clear storytelling around customer needs and business opportunities
  • Work cross-functionally with product management, engineering, and design peers
  • Create, collaborate, and iterate on flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals
  • Design and ship high-quality features and product improvements
  • Be a mentor and provide thoughtful feedback to your peers (and benefit from strong personal and professional mentorship opportunities yourself!)

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience working as a product designer
  • 3+ years of experience working on a software product with similar scale or complexity
  • Experience using node-based design tools or broader design/ development tools
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; you’re able to explain your design decisions and strategy with clear rationale and storytelling
  • Great attention to detail, and an eye for visual craft, such as composition, typography, and layout

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with technical things like HTML/CSS, prototyping tools such as Origami, or advanced Figma features like Auto Layout, Variables, and Components
  • Past experience designing for developers, or partnering closely with developing on complex problems
  • A design/development hybrid background, or experience building websites or apps
  • A history of working on canvas-based interfaces or tools that support creative workflows

region: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:

Figma helps teams turn ideas into products. Our Customer Operations & Support team helps customers use Figma and brings customer needs into operational and product decisions.

As a Technical Operations & Insights Analyst, you will help shape where Support invests and how it scales. Reporting to the Manager of Workforce Management & Data Insights, you will combine hands-on analysis with metric development and cross-functional program leadership. You will identify opportunities across channel effectiveness, education, automation, and product improvements; assess their potential; and recommend priorities based on customer outcomes, quality, capacity, and cost. You will lead the work that turns those recommendations into measurable outcomes.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Identify and size opportunities to improve customer outcomes and operating efficiency. Turn ambiguous questions into investment recommendations, including when to proceed, test, defer, or stop
  • Develop trusted measures, including cost per support interaction. Agree definitions, cost allocation, exclusions, and ownership with operational and financial partners
  • Use SQL and Python or R to build reproducible analyses, data models, and reporting. Use git, peer review, and responsible AI-assisted workflows to develop, validate, and document the work
  • Apply statistical inference to operational decisions, including observational comparisons, uncertainty, and sensitivity analysis. Explain the assumptions and limits of the evidence
  • Build scenarios that connect costs, benefits, capacity, and customer outcomes. Partner with Finance to evaluate investment tradeoffs and define how results will be measured
  • Lead cross-functional analytical programs from scope through delivery, adoption, and outcome review. Establish owners, milestones, dependencies, and decision points with partner teams
  • Communicate complex findings through clear writing and purposeful visualizations that make recommendations, tradeoffs, and uncertainty understandable
  • Build adoption and sustained use into delivery through documentation, appropriate data-quality checks, and agreed ongoing ownership

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years in analytics, strategy and operations, or a related analytical role, with a track record of influencing operational decisions
  • Strong SQL and hands-on Python or R, working reproducibly with git and peer review, plus practical fluency with AI-assisted tools, including validating their output and owning the result
  • Sound statistical and financial judgment: developing metrics, evaluating observational comparisons and uncertainty, and building basic scenarios that clarify costs, benefits, and tradeoffs
  • A record of delivering cross-functional work from scope through adoption, including aligning stakeholders with conflicting priorities and challenging assumptions with evidence and respect
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication, including concise data storytelling for senior leaders and creative approaches to framing complex problems

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Customer support, customer experience, service operations, or cost-to-serve analytics
  • Experience with dbt, Snowflake, Hex, or comparable analytical toolsets
  • Experiment design, automation measurement, or evaluation of changes to customer workflows
  • Deeper financial modeling, workforce planning, or coaching other analysts
  • Experience designing in Figma

title: Partner Director, KPMG Global
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work cross-functionally across Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success to translate strategic partnerships into measurable outcomes for customers.

Global advisory and professional services partners help enterprises move from AI strategy to production deployment. This role will lead OpenAI’s global partnership with KPMG, bringing together its advisory, industry, technology transformation, and delivery capabilities with OpenAI’s products and platform. You will build the strategy, executive alignment, and operating model needed to turn the partnership into repeatable customer and commercial impact across regions and industries.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partner Director, KPMG Global to serve as the single accountable owner of OpenAI’s strategic relationship with KPMG globally. You will define the partnership strategy and joint business plan, build trusted executive relationships, and align KPMG’s global, regional, member-firm, industry, technical, and delivery leaders to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role with responsibility for the health, performance, and long-term expansion of the partnership. You will move between senior executive engagement, joint account and opportunity strategy, solution development, field enablement, governance, and day-to-day execution. You will align global priorities with regional execution and help customers move from initial AI strategy through secure implementation, production adoption, and expansion.

The ideal candidate has led a global alliance with KPMG or a comparable professional services organization, delivered measurable pipeline and customer outcomes, and built operating models that connect executive commitments to field behavior and successful deployments. You will bring commercial discipline, technical fluency, and the ability to align complex organizations while remaining accountable for results.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the global KPMG partnership, including alliance strategy, executive alignment, joint planning, pipeline growth, customer outcomes, delivery quality, and multi-year expansion.

  • Develop and execute a joint business plan with clear priorities, investments, decision rights, regional responsibilities, milestones, and measures of success.

  • Serve as OpenAI’s senior counterpart to KPMG’s global, regional, and member-firm leadership. Build relationships across advisory, industry practices, technology, alliance, client-account, and delivery teams to set priorities and resolve escalations.

  • Translate global partnership strategy into coordinated regional execution, working with OpenAI partner sales and account teams to establish clear ownership and consistent field engagement.

  • Lead joint account mapping, opportunity qualification, and strategic customer pursuits, aligning OpenAI and KPMG teams around differentiated customer value and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Shape joint solutions and industry-specific transformation offerings that combine OpenAI capabilities with KPMG’s advisory, business transformation, data, technology, risk, and governance expertise.

  • Engage with senior customer executives alongside KPMG leaders to connect AI strategy, business priorities, implementation plans, and long-term value realization.

  • Create repeatable co-sell and delivery motions covering seller engagement, technical discovery, solution validation, delivery handoffs, production readiness, and customer expansion.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Security, Legal, Finance, and Customer Success to remove technical, contractual, compliance, and operational blockers across priority engagements.

  • Build partner capability through field enablement, technical readiness, reusable solution patterns, and clear expectations for implementation quality and customer success.

  • Establish executive governance, business reviews, pipeline inspection, forecasting, performance reporting, and escalation mechanisms that create accountability across both organizations.

  • Define and monitor partnership KPIs, including qualified pipeline, conversion, revenue, production adoption, customer value, partner readiness, delivery quality, and return on OpenAI investment.

  • Prioritize OpenAI resources across joint opportunities based on strategic alignment, commercial potential, customer impact, delivery readiness, and repeatability.

  • Work with Legal, Security, and relevant partner teams to establish clear standards for responsible AI deployment, intellectual property, delivery quality, and applicable independence and conflict-of-interest requirements across joint engagements and co-developed assets.

  • Represent OpenAI in senior partner, customer, and industry engagements, and help build the team capacity and operating model needed to scale the global alliance over time.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience leading strategic alliances, global advisory or professional services partnerships, ecosystem sales, business development, or enterprise GTM programs in AI, cloud, data, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • Deep familiarity with KPMG or a comparable global professional services organization, including partner economics, member-firm and regional decision-making, executive influence networks, and enterprise delivery models.

  • Proven ownership of global, multi-year strategic partnerships with executive accountability and measurable pipeline, revenue, adoption, deployment, or customer outcomes.

  • Experience designing and scaling joint operating models across large, matrixed organizations, including governance, account planning, resource allocation, enablement, delivery handoffs, and escalation.

  • Demonstrated success shaping and advancing complex enterprise transformation opportunities, engaging senior executives, and navigating procurement, security, legal, and implementation requirements.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to earn trust with global partner leaders and customer executives while remaining close to commercial and operating details.

  • Commercial judgment and experience qualifying opportunities, managing forecasts, prioritizing investments, and making clear tradeoffs across regions, industries, and customer segments.

  • Technical fluency across enterprise AI, data, cloud and hybrid environments, integration, security, governance, and modern application architectures.

  • Experience translating technology capabilities into differentiated industry solutions and repeatable partner-led customer engagements.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to align Sales, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and external partner teams without direct authority.

  • Prior people leadership experience, with the ability to coach others, develop talent, and build team capacity as the partnership scales.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions and cultures.

  • A builder mindset, high ownership, low ego, and comfort creating structure and momentum in an evolving environment while maintaining a consistent focus on customer value and responsible AI adoption.

What success looks like:

  • OpenAI and KPMG have a clear global partnership strategy, differentiated joint value proposition, executive governance model, and measurable business plan.

  • Global and regional teams operate with clear responsibilities, shared priorities, and consistent co-sell and delivery motions.

  • The partnership generates qualified pipeline and converts priority opportunities into secure production deployments with demonstrable customer value.

  • Joint solutions and industry offerings become repeatable across accounts and regions, supported by growing partner sales and delivery readiness.

  • OpenAI resources are directed toward the highest-impact opportunities, and the alliance delivers sustained customer adoption and commercial growth.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

title: Subject Matter Expert, Legal
description:
About the Team

We are building AI systems that help people tackle complex, consequential work in the legal industry. Law demands careful reasoning, precise language, and sound judgment: understanding the facts, identifying the right questions, weighing competing interpretations, and helping clients decide what to do next. We see an opportunity for AI to help legal professionals work with greater rigor and focus more of their time on the problems that matter most.

Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to build AI capabilities and products for legal work. Our customers include the top law firms in the world as well as in-house legal departments of some of the largest businesses in the world. We translate the realities of practice into evaluations, training signals, and useful tools, with the ambition of making AI a trusted part of how lawyers research, analyze, draft, and advise.

About the Role

We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Law who brings the judgment and practical experience developed in a law firm to shaping the next generation of AI. You will help define what excellent legal work looks like, test where our models meet that standard, and turn your findings into better model behavior and product experiences.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of legal practice and AI development. You will work directly with legal materials, model outputs, evaluation rubrics, and product prototypes. Your expertise will help us tackle some of the hardest questions in legal AI, including how to assess reasoning when there is no single correct answer.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Define the quality bar for what top-notch legal work looks like, drawing on real matters and the standards lawyers apply to research, analysis, drafting, document review, and client advice.

  • Design challenging, realistic AI model evaluations with representative facts, source materials, constraints, and deliverables, including cases that test ambiguity, competing arguments, and professional judgment.

  • Create and review reference work such as research memoranda, contract analyses, redlines, diligence findings, and draft legal documents that demonstrate strong reasoning and practical usefulness.

  • Develop rubrics that assess legal accuracy, issue spotting, factual grounding, citation validity, jurisdictional context, and the appropriate treatment of uncertainty.

  • Evaluate model outputs and complete legal workflows, identify recurring failures, and give researchers and engineers specific, actionable feedback supported by examples and corrected work.

  • Partner with Research on datasets, grading methods, and training tasks or environments that strengthen legal reasoning. Test whether model changes address the underlying problems and improve performance on new cases.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to identify valuable use cases, prototype workflows, and translate lessons from evaluations into experiences that fit how lawyers actually work.

  • Collaborate with legal professionals and design partners to refine our standards and test usefulness in practice, applying sound judgment around confidentiality, privilege, data permissions, and professional responsibility.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

  • Have practiced law at a law firm, with substantial experience producing and reviewing work for real client matters. We care more about demonstrated judgment and quality of work matter over title or firm pedigree.

  • Bring deep expertise in one or more practice areas, such as commercial transactions, corporate law, litigation, or regulatory work, and curiosity about workflows beyond your specialty.

  • Are an excellent legal researcher and writer who can assess authorities, distinguish strong arguments from plausible ones, and explain how facts and context affect a conclusion.

  • Can make expert judgment explicit: explain why an answer is incomplete, a clause creates risk, or an analysis misses the central issue, and describe what better work would look like.

  • Enjoy working directly with AI tools, exploring their limits, and testing ideas systematically. You can collaborate closely with technical teams and communicate clearly across disciplines.

  • Take ownership in ambiguous settings and are willing to build the first version of an evaluation, reference document, rubric, or workflow, then improve it through feedback.

  • Care deeply about the quality and consequences of legal work, and are motivated by the opportunity to help shape how AI supports the profession.

Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have:

  • Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or review frameworks for legal work or frontier AI systems.

  • A track record of improving legal workflows through technology, knowledge management, automation, or new ways of working.

  • Experience training or supervising lawyers, developing practice guidance, or translating complex legal concepts for different audiences.

title: Deal Intelligence Analyst
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon

About the Deal Desk Team

The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.

Role Summary

As a Deal Intelligence Analyst, you will be the analytical engine driving our transition to a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk. Sitting within the Finance function, you will design the data systems and executive dashboards that allow our deal architects to analyze complex deal terms, protect margins, and close large, complex commitment deals with unprecedented velocity.

This role is designed for a "full-stack" analyst. You won't just be querying pre-cleaned data—you possess the technical skills to build the pipelines that feed your insights. You will leverage Cloudflare's Developer Platform (Workers, R2, D1, Workers AI) alongside standard data warehousing tools to extract raw CRM and CPQ data, integrate it into AI workflows, and deliver actionable insights that directly impact margin preservation and our global growth.

What you’ll do

  • Build Advanced Dashboards & Analytics: Design and maintain executive dashboards and self-serve reporting systems that provide real-time visibility into deal terms, discount thresholds, win/loss rates, and margin performance across all regions.
  • Transform Ideas into Reality: Work with stakeholders and help them refine their ideas and goals into queries that we’ll automate.
  • Drive Strategic Margin Analysis: Partner closely with Finance, Infrastructure and Deal Desk leadership to dive deep into historic and active pricing data, uncovering insights that ensure our quoting strategies consistently align with margin preservation goals.
  • Develop Data Pipelines: Apply your data engineering skills to build and maintain data cleansing tools that help refine data from Salesforce, CPQ, and billing systems, transforming it into clean, usable semantic models.
  • Power AI Workflows: Assist in integrating structured deal data into Deal Desk tools to help automate routine approvals and surface real-time pricing optimizations to deal managers.
  • Data Storytelling & Enablement: Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders, empowering the Deal Desk team to use your data products for faster, data-driven negotiations.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3-5+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a technical RevOps role, with a strong emphasis on full-stack data problem solving.
  • Experience incorporating data into AI workflows, utilizing LLM orchestration frameworks, or building predictive models.
  • Proven experience designing analytical data models; domain expertise in financial and SaaS metrics (e.g. margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR) is a strong plus
  • Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.
  • Experience designing analytical data models specifically tailored for financial and SaaS business analysis (e.g., margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR).
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms and an interest in edge computing/serverless architectures (Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1).
  • Expertise, or interest in learning, CRM data structures (especially Salesforce custom objects), CPQ complexities, and the quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  • Solid communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data systems and operations.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Background working closely with Deal Desk, Finance, RevOps or Sales Strategy teams at a high-growth SaaS or technology company is a plus
  • Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.
  • SQL and deep proficiency in modern data visualization and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Sigma, PowerBI) to build intuitive executive reporting.
  • Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and orchestration tools (like Airflow).
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or other analytics databases

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

About the Role

The Interconnection Manager for the Americas is the network strategy leader for one of Cloudflare's most important and most contrasted regions — a mature, high-volume United States market alongside a fast-growing, infrastructure-constrained South America. You will own the strategy that scales our connectivity with the largest ISPs and eyeball networks in the U.S. while solving the harder, less-charted problem of building resilient, cost-effective network reach across South America.

This role operates on an AI-first model. You won't just consume reports — you'll use AI agents and tooling to analyze traffic, model capacity and cost scenarios, surface peering and transport opportunities, and automate the operational work that historically slowed interconnection teams down. AI is the force-multiplier that lets a single strategist see the whole region clearly and act on it quickly, shifting your time from reactive task processing to proactive architecture. The decisions you make will directly shape Cloudflare's standing as the network leader across the Americas.

You will work in close partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager, who executes high-volume sourcing, contract lifecycle, and vendor management under your strategic direction — freeing you to lead the complex, high-stakes work.

What You'll Do / Responsibilities

Regional Network Strategy — Americas

  • Own and execute the interconnection and backbone strategy for the Americas, balancing the distinct realities of the U.S. and South American markets.
  • United States: Drive interconnection scale and depth with the largest U.S. ISPs and eyeball networks (e.g., Comcast, Charter, AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile), expanding private interconnect, peering, and capacity to keep pace with traffic growth.
  • South America: Solve the region's unique build challenges — a sparse and uneven IXP fabric, terrestrial and subsea transport economics, regulatory and market fragmentation, and heavy reliance on local partners — to establish durable, performant reach (with particular focus on Brazil, the region's largest market).

AI-First Operating Model

  • Use AI-driven analytics to interpret regional traffic patterns, peering opportunities, and performance/cost trade-offs, and to inform interconnection and capacity decisions.
  • Leverage and help shape automated, agentic workflows for LOAs, ticketing, contract tracking, and data hygiene — partnering with the support layer to push routine execution to automation.
  • Build models and scenario analyses (capacity, cost, resiliency) that let you make faster, better-evidenced strategic calls and clearly defend them to leadership.

Interconnection & Backbone Management

  • Formulate and execute plans to optimize traffic flow across the region, balancing backbone, partner, transit, IX, and peer connections.
  • Develop and execute strategies for the expansion, optimization, and maintenance of Cloudflare's backbone across the Americas, planning capacity for scalability and high performance.
  • Lead negotiations for high-value, complex interconnection agreements and Tier-1 partnerships.
  • Advise budget planning cycles to ensure proper resource allocation for regional growth and scaling.

Partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager

  • Set the strategy and priorities the Network Acquisition Manager executes against; review and approve sourcing recommendations for new and existing transport services.
  • Lead complex, high-value negotiations directly, while the Acquisition Manager runs high-volume requirements, contract lifecycle support, inventory, and first-level billing response.
  • Ensure a clean handoff model so strategic intent translates into reliable, well-documented execution.

  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with ISPs, IXPs, carriers, and partners across the Americas.
  • Act as the regional expert for interconnection relationships, focused on availability, capacity, effectiveness, and cost efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Data Center Strategy, Network Engineering, Capacity Planning, and Infrastructure Operations to align on network strategy and implementation.
  • Engage internal stakeholders to plan requirements and deliver cross-functional projects, communicating clearly throughout.

Industry Engagement

  • Represent Cloudflare in regional and global industry forums and conferences, contributing to best practices and standards.

  • 5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, ideally within a Telco, ISP, CDN, or cloud environment.
  • Strong understanding of networking protocols and technologies, including BGP, DWDM, and IP networking.
  • Proven experience negotiating and managing interconnection agreements.
  • Working knowledge of the Americas connectivity landscape — the U.S. wholesale/peering market and the transport, IXP, and partner dynamics of South America (including subsea and terrestrial considerations).
  • Fluency with AI tools in daily work, and a genuine appetite to use AI/agentic tooling to scale decision-making and eliminate manual toil.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with capacity planning, cost modeling, and operations research.

Bonus Points

  • Professional proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, to support relationship-building and network expansion across South America.
  • Hands-on experience building or scaling network presence in emerging or infrastructure-constrained markets.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted analytics or automation for network/commercial operations.

title: Senior Certificate Authority Architect
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Cloudflare is building a new public Certificate Authority for the Internet. We are looking for a senior technical architect to help define the systems, protocols, and security architecture behind it.

This role spans applied cryptography, Web PKI, distributed systems, security engineering, compliance, and Internet standards. It will help Cloudflare build a CA that operates safely at Internet scale while establishing a credible path from today's X.509 ecosystem toward post-quantum authentication using Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs).

Mission

Define and guide the end-to-end architecture of Cloudflare's public Certificate Authority: a high-assurance, highly available system capable of issuing conventional publicly trusted certificates at Cloudflare scale while supporting Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs) and the evolution toward a post-quantum Web PKI.

You will help determine not only how the CA is implemented, but also its trust boundaries, key hierarchy, issuance architecture, auditability, failure modes, incident response mechanisms, and long-term cryptographic evolution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture of Cloudflare's public CA across certificate issuance, key management, transparency, revocation, renewal, and relying-party integration.
  • Design root and intermediate CA trust hierarchies, signing systems, HSM integration, key ceremonies, key rotation, backup, recovery, migration, and key-compromise response.
  • Architect secure, resilient, and highly available issuance services capable of operating at Internet scale and across multiple geographic and failure domains.
  • Design certificate lifecycle systems around ACME, domain and IP validation, CAA, Certificate Transparency, pre-issuance linting, revocation, renewal, and large-scale certificate replacement.
  • Integrate Cloudflare’s MTC infrastructure, including CA logs, landmarks,, cosigning or mirroring, and interactions with relying parties.
  • Develop practical architectures for coexistence and migration between classical X.509 certificates and post-quantum authentication mechanisms.
  • Define trust boundaries, security properties, and threat models covering key compromise, unauthorized issuance, software supply-chain compromise, operator error, malicious insiders, infrastructure failure, split views, and cryptographic migration.
  • Design systems that make CA behavior observable and independently verifiable through transparency mechanisms, reproducible builds, cryptographic attestations, public operational telemetry, tamper-evident evidence, and audit controls.
  • Design failure containment and recovery mechanisms that support safe certificate replacement, revocation, key rotation, and incident response without creating avoidable Internet availability failures.
  • Translate CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser and operating-system root-program policies, audit criteria, and certification requirements into concrete technical and operational controls.
  • Review protocols, architecture, and implementations with an adversarial mindset, identifying assumptions and failure modes that do not hold at Internet scale.
  • Work closely with Cloudflare's cryptography, TLS, security, networking, infrastructure, compliance, product, and operations teams.
  • Provide architectural direction, design review, and technical mentorship to engineers implementing and operating the CA platform.
  • Represent Cloudflare in relevant standards and industry work, collaborating with browser vendors, root programs, researchers, auditors, CA operators, and the wider Web PKI community.

What You'll Bring

  • Substantial experience designing or operating security-critical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of: public Certificate Authorities, Web PKI, applied cryptography, TLS and Internet security protocols, Certificate Transparency, hardware-backed key management, or large-scale distributed security systems.
  • Strong knowledge of certificate trust chains, issuance and validation, revocation, key lifecycle management, and the security and availability implications of CA design decisions.
  • Experience defining system trust boundaries, threat models, security invariants, and failure-handling strategies.
  • Ability to reason about systems in which a subtle architectural or operational mistake can affect a significant fraction of the Internet.
  • Experience leading architecture across multiple engineering teams without relying solely on organizational authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain cryptographic and architectural tradeoffs to engineers, auditors, standards participants, and senior stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating with substantial autonomy in an evolving technical and policy environment.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

  • Define objectives for every event (brand, demand, pipeline, or customer expansion) and align cross-functional teams around them before work begins.

Lead Hosted Events End-to-End

  • Build the cross-functional team and run-of-show for each event, managing agencies, vendors, speakers, and internal stakeholders to deliver a polished, on-brand experience.
  • Own the hosted-event budget, timeline, and risk plan end to end, holding a high quality bar while shipping on schedule.

Drive Sponsored Presence, Experience & Thought Leadership

  • Lead booth strategy and experience design on the expo floor: creative concept, floor plan, demos, staffing, swag, and lead capture — creating a presence that stands out in a crowded hall.
  • Drive our thought leadership motion: speaker submissions, session strategy, keynote/theater content, executive briefings, and customer story placement.
  • Negotiate and manage sponsorships and branding opportunities, and design activations and on-site moments that break through and earn attention.

Activate the Sales Field

  • Build and run the field activation motion for every Tier 1 show and hosted event: pre-event briefings, target account mapping, meeting-booking playbooks, staffing plans, and post-event follow-up cadence.

  • Proven track record leading complex, high-budget event programs ($1M+ annual budgets), including producing hosted events (venue, content, production, registration) and running sponsorships, booth builds, and executive programming at third-party conferences.

  • Experience managing agencies and developing interns or junior marketers.
  • Agility and comfort shifting between hosted and sponsored programs as the calendar demands.
  • Experience working with AI tools (OpenCode, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to build solutions, automate workflows, and solve problems, not just consume outputs.

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to take ownership of vendor contracting at Supabase. You will be the go-to contracts partner for everything we buy.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with real ownership, for an experienced negotiator who takes pride in making procurement faster while managing risk. You will negotiate directly, build the playbooks and workflows that let the business self-serve on low-risk deals, and escalate the right issues to Legal at the right time. We work AI-first in Legal: you will use Claude and Ironclad every day to move faster and with greater accuracy. Your work will shape how procurement and vendor contracting scale as Supabase grows.

What You Will Do

Own vendor contracting end to end

  • Review, draft, and negotiate a high volume of vendor agreements, including MSAs, order forms, SOWs, SaaS and cloud subscription terms, DPAs, and NDAs.

  • Serve as the single point of contact for all vendor contracting matters raised by FinOps, IT, Security, and business owners, from intake through signature, renewals, amendments, disputes, and offboarding. As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters.

  • Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk.

  • Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it.

  • Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes.

Build and scale vendor contracting operations

  • Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks.

  • Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps.

  • Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks.

  • Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 6 to 8+ years of experience negotiating procurement, vendor, or technology transactions contracting, ideally buy-side at a U.S. SaaS or technology company, with deep knowledge of SaaS, cloud, and software licensing terms.

  • A track record of negotiating directly with vendors and their counsel, independently and at pace.

  • Strong working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security terms in commercial contracts, including DPA negotiation and international data transfers.

  • Experience designing contracting processes that are consistent, transparent, and easy for the business to follow.

  • Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain legal and commercial risk plainly and the judgment to know when to hold a position, approve a reasonable risk, or escalate.

  • Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information.

Preferred

  • A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree.

  • Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side.

  • Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a similar CLM tool (Juro, Docusign CLM) or building AI-assisted legal workflows, ideally with some exposure to AI governance.

  • Experience working across jurisdictions or with distributed, international teams.

  • Experience at a fast-growing, developer-focused, cloud, security, or open source company.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
