title: Lead Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer, Design Systems to shape the design system behind HighLevel's product experience, used by product teams across the company and by our developer community. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products and evolving design systems used by multiple teams.

Speed has always been a core HighLevel virtue, and AI-assisted building by designers, product managers and engineers is making us faster still. Our design system must keep pace: beyond tokens and components, it needs primitives, templates and guidance that help every AI-assisted build start from strong defaults.

As a lead individual contributor on the Design Systems team, you will treat the system as a product with its own customers, roadmap and success measures, partnering closely with design leadership, front-end engineers and product teams.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate advanced visual and interaction design judgment, deep systems thinking and the ability to raise quality through standards, documentation, critique and mentorship.

You should embrace AI as central to how you work, not an add-on. This role is based in India, with flexibility for candidates in the United States or the United Kingdom. Experience designing B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Applications without a portfolio that includes design system work will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Lead strategy and execution for one or more areas of the design system, grounded in product needs, usage data and technical constraints

  • Define and evolve visual foundations, including tokens, theming, color, typography, spacing, iconography and motion

  • Design and refine components and patterns, including anatomy, states, variants, responsive behavior, edge cases and failure states

  • Create primitives, templates and starter kits that help teams build quickly with AI tools while staying on-system

  • Encode visual, interaction, content and accessibility rules as documentation and machine-readable guidance that AI coding tools and agents can follow

  • Partner with front-end engineers on token architecture, component APIs and implementation fidelity so Figma, documentation and code stay in sync

  • Shape contribution, versioning, deprecation and governance models that let the system grow without fragmentation

  • Guide product teams onto the system, study how it's used in what ships and feed what you learn back into it

  • Drive innovation by staying ahead of emerging trends in design and technology

  • Set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality and visual consistency, and mentor designers through critique and system reviews

  • Collaborate effectively across US, UK and India time zones in a 100% remote environment


What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including building or leading a multi-team design system

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio with at least one system-level case study that covers your role, architecture, governance and measurable impact

  • Advanced visual and interaction design craft, with strong care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality

  • Expert command of Figma libraries, variables, modes, component properties and token pipelines, with a record of architecting scalable systems across teams and connecting them to AI tools

  • Deep fluency in front-end development, including HTML, CSS and component frameworks such as React or Vue, with the ability to review implementations for fidelity

  • Hands-on experience vibe coding prototypes with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to test primitives, templates and patterns before production

  • Deep knowledge of WCAG and hands-on experience designing and testing accessible components

  • A clear point of view on how design systems should support AI-assisted development, plus experience designing AI-driven or intelligent interfaces

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders through rationale, evidence and craft

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for consistency, craft and product quality across the teams that build with the system

  • You thrive at high shipping velocity and see the design system as what makes speed and quality compatible

  • You know when a problem needs a new primitive or component and when it needs better guidance

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

title: Sr. Product Analyst – Lead Generation
description:
About HighLevel

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

About the Team

The Lead Generation Team owns some of the most important products businesses use to build their digital presence and generate leads on HighLevel.

Our product portfolio includes Funnels, Websites, AI Studio, Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, Domains, Media, QR Codes, Listings, SEO, Analytics, Tracking, and other lead-generation experiences.

Millions of funnels, websites, forms, and other digital experiences are created using HighLevel. Our goal is to help agencies and businesses not only create these experiences but continuously improve their ability to attract visitors, capture leads, and drive conversions.

Data plays a critical role in how we make product decisions. We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst who can independently lead analytical work, deepen our understanding of customer behavior, identify growth opportunities, and help Product Managers make faster, better-informed decisions.

About the Role

HighLevel is looking for a highly analytical and product-minded Senior Product Analyst to join our Lead Generation Product team.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM teams to understand how customers discover, adopt, and use our products—and where the most meaningful opportunities exist to improve their experience.

You will own analytical projects end to end: framing the right questions, defining the approach, validating the data, conducting the analysis, and translating findings into clear recommendations. Your work will span the complete customer journey, from activation and feature adoption to engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on independent ownership, product judgment, and cross-functional influence. Beyond delivering reports, you will proactively surface opportunities, challenge assumptions, and help Product Managers determine what we should build, why we should build it, and whether what we shipped actually worked.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end product analyses across Funnels, Websites, Forms, Surveys, Domains, SEO, Listings, and other LeadGen products, turning ambiguous questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.

  • Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics and measurement frameworks for product areas and initiatives, covering activation, adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization.

  • Build and maintain dashboards that give Product Managers and leadership clear visibility into product health, emerging trends, and business outcomes, while enabling teams to answer recurring questions independently.

  • Lead funnel and journey analyses to identify friction and drop-offs across onboarding, creation, publishing, lead capture, and other critical workflows.

  • Conduct cohort, segmentation, and retention analyses to understand differences across customer segments, usage patterns, and lifecycle stages—and identify where targeted improvements could have the greatest impact.

  • Partner with Product Managers to size opportunities, validate hypotheses, evaluate trade-offs, and prioritize initiatives based on potential customer and business impact.

  • Define measurement plans before feature launches, establish baselines, and evaluate adoption and outcomes after release. Communicate what the evidence supports, where uncertainty remains, and what to do next.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to define events, properties, tracking requirements, and instrumentation, ensuring critical customer journeys can be measured reliably.

  • Proactively identify data quality issues and tracking gaps, investigate their impact, and work with relevant teams to improve the consistency and reliability of product analytics.

  • Designand analyze A/B tests and product experiments, including hypotheses, success metrics, guardrail metrics, and interpretation of results, to support statistically sound decisions.

  • Contribute to requirements definition and feature validation across multiple initiatives, including success criteria and pre-launch validation.

  • Lead customer research, including interviews and surveys, and combine it with quantitative data and support-ticket signalsLead deep-dive and root-cause analyses when important metrics change unexpectedly, distinguishing meaningful shifts from data issues, seasonality, or changes in customer mix.

  • Proactively recommend opportunities to improve lead generation, conversion rates, product adoption, engagement, and retention, and partner with teams to assess the results of resulting changes.

  • Present complex findings as clear, decision-oriented narratives, explaining recommendations, trade-offs, assumptions, and limitations to Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and leadership.

  • Contribute to shared analytical practices, metric definitions, and documentation, bringing customer and LeadGen domain context to the numbers rather than reporting metrics in isolation.

  • Mentor junior analysts and facilitate discovery discussions with Product, Design and Engineering

Requirements

  • 4-7 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related analytical role, with demonstrated experience informing product decisions.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and working independently with large datasets.

  • Demonstrated ability to own analytical projects end to end, from clarifying an ambiguous problem to delivering recommendations and following through on outcomes.

  • Experience leading customer research (interviews, surveys) and competitive analysis.

  • Experience with product analytics or BI tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar platforms.

  • Strong understanding of product metrics such as activation, adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, churn, and monetization, including how to select appropriate metrics for different product goals.

  • Hands-on experience with funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, retention analysis, and user journey analysis.

  • Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests or product experiments, with a practical understanding of hypothesis testing, statistical significance, and common analytical biases.

  • Working knowledge of event-based analytics, instrumentation, and tracking plans, with experience identifying data quality issues and validating analytical inputs.

  • Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, along with the ability to build clear dashboards and communicate findings through effective data visualization.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and other cross-functional teams to influence prioritization and product improvements.

  • Ability to communicate complex findings in simple business terms, make clear recommendations, and explain assumptions and limitations.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize analytical work based on its potential impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis, including libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, pixels, attribution, or web analytics.

  • Understanding of websites, funnels, conversion rate optimization, digital marketing, or lead-generation products.

  • Experience working in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, website builders, or high-growth technology companies.

  • Familiarity with APIs and an ability to understand how data flows between systems.

  • Experience improving analytics workflows, documenting reusable approaches, or helping teammates strengthen their analytical skills.

Preferred Soft Skills

  • Curiosity to go beyond what happened and understand why it happened and what we should do next.

  • Strong product and customer judgment, with the ability to connect analytical findings to real customer problems.

  • Comfort independently navigating ambiguity and balancing rigor with the need to make timely decisions.

  • Confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions without formal authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor the level of detail to the audience.

  • Strong ownership and collaboration skills in a fast-moving, remote environment.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Product Analyst in the Lead Generation team will help us move from “we think this is happening” to “we understand what is happening, why it matters, and what we should do next.”

Product teams will have clearer success metrics, more reliable measurement, and a stronger understanding of customer behavior. Important opportunities and risks will be surfaced proactively, and launches and experiments will produce actionable learning—not just reports.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, roadmap prioritization, experimentation, and investment decisions across HighLevel’s Lead Generation portfolio.

title: Lead Technical Instructor
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s engineers are building some of the most ambitious AI systems and applications in the world. We also help engineers, architects, and technical practitioners across Anthropic, our partners, and our customers learn to build with Claude.

Until now, technical instruction has largely been a shared responsibility. We are building a dedicated technical instruction function to make that learning exceptional and ensure that everyone who teaches in Anthropic’s technical programs meets a consistent, high bar.

We are looking for a Technical Instructor Lead in New York to help bring that standard to life. About half of your time will be spent delivering ILT hands-on technical instruction in New York and remotely across European time zones. The other half will be spent developing other instructors, running train-the-trainer programs, and improving the quality and consistency of technical instruction across programs.

You are an engineer who teaches and a teacher who makes other teachers better. You can build an agent live in front of a skeptical staff engineer, diagnose a broken lab while a room of learners waits, and adapt when a lesson is not landing. You can also watch another instructor teach for ten minutes and identify the one change that will materially improve their next session.

This is not primarily an instructional design or classroom facilitation role. You should be comfortable writing code, debugging technical systems, and teaching practitioners who may know more than you do about their particular domain.

You will report to the Head of Technical Training.

Key responsibilities

  • Deliver hands-on technical instruction across Anthropic’s onboarding, residency, and technical enablement programs, in person in New York and remotely across European time zones.
  • Model excellent technical teaching for audiences ranging from small, interactive labs to 100+ technical practitioners, adapting to different levels of experience and technical depth.
  • Run train-the-trainer programs for internal experts, contract instructors, and training partners, using Anthropic’s practice-teach, feedback, and certification processes.
  • Coach and calibrate instructors through live and recorded observations, actionable feedback, and recommendations on readiness to teach specific content.
  • Partner with technical experts to turn subject matter expertise into effective sessions, labs, exercises, and demonstrations, and improve content based on what happens in the room.
  • Own instructional quality in assigned programs, staffing yourself and cleared instructors into East Coast program calendars and ensuring delivery meets Anthropic’s standards.
  • Use learner and instructor data to identify gaps in instruction and recommend improvements to curriculum, delivery, and instructor development.
  • Help evolve Anthropic’s technical instruction function, bringing your experience from the room into our standards, instructor development practices, and approach to scaling quality.

Minimum qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience across software engineering, solutions engineering, developer advocacy, technical education, or another technically deep role.
  • 3+ years of hands-on technical instruction, including teaching engineers in live environments both in person and remotely. You know how to make difficult technical concepts click and how to adapt when they do not.
  • Production engineering experience. You have written and shipped production software and can engage credibly with experienced engineers on architecture, implementation, debugging, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Recent hands-on AI development. Within the past three years, you have built or debugged applications using LLM APIs, agents, tool use, MCP, or related technologies. You are comfortable with rapidly changing AI development tools and unfamiliar technical problems.
  • Instructor development experience. You have helped other instructors or technical presenters improve through observation, structured feedback, practice teaching, or train-the-trainer programs.
  • New York City location or willingness to relocate. You will work from our NYC office whenever an instructor-led program is in session there, typically around three days per week. The role includes approximately 25% travel to San Francisco and, over time, Europe.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating a train-the-trainer, instructor certification, or observer-calibration program.
  • A portfolio of sessions, labs, or courses you have designed and taught, plus material you created so others could teach it.
  • Experience teaching across time zones or to European audiences, including coaching instructors from recorded sessions.
  • Experience using Claude Code or a comparable agentic coding tool as a significant part of your engineering workflow.
  • Experience building with the Claude Developer Platform through Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry, or comparable infrastructure.
  • Experience with public speaking, conference workshops, or developer advocacy.
  • Deep enthusiasm for AI and a genuine commitment to building and deploying it responsibly.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$270,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Content Designer
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The ChatGPT team works across research, engineering, product, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to the world. We serve a diverse audience of users who are already using ChatGPT daily in their lives and work.

We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth.

About the role

We’re looking for a Content Designer to join OpenAI’s Content Design team, bringing deep expertise in prompt engineering and AI evaluation alongside strong content design craft and product judgment.

You’ll combine editorial judgment, product strategy, and technical implementation to build prompts, evaluations, and tools that help us create and improve content and messaging at scale. Your primary focus will be experiences that help people discover ChatGPT’s value, get started, and stay engaged—including notifications—with contributions to broader Content Design work as team needs evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Shape content strategy for experiences that help people discover ChatGPT’s value, get started, and return to meaningful uses of the product.

  • Design, implement, and iterate on prompt frameworks that guide AI-generated product content and messaging.

  • Define content quality standards and build evaluation systems, datasets, and reviewer guidance that combine human judgment with automated assessments.

  • Shape tools and workflows for generating, reviewing, and improving content across experiments and product experiences.

  • Analyze model outputs and evaluation results to diagnose problems and improve content systems as models, products, and user needs evolve.

  • Partner with product, engineering, design, research, and data science to connect content quality with user understanding, trust, engagement, and retention.

  • Document reusable approaches and coach other Content Designers in developing prompts, defining evaluation criteria, and interpreting results.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring 5+ years of experience in content design, content engineering, or a related discipline, with a track record of delivering work across complex product areas.

  • Have hands-on experience developing prompts for shipped generative AI experiences and understand model capabilities, limitations, and failure patterns.

  • Have designed and implemented content evaluation frameworks—and validated how reliably they assess quality.

  • Have hands-on experience using code and APIs to build repeatable generation and evaluation workflows, and can partner with Engineering to integrate them into production.

  • Bring strong writing, editorial judgment, and content strategy skills that you can apply across product experiences.

  • Can turn qualitative and quantitative evidence into clear recommendations and demonstrate how your work improved content quality, team effectiveness, or product outcomes.

  • Collaborate effectively across technical and nontechnical teams, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous problems and evolving requirements.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Incident Manager, Safeguards
region: Boston, MA / San Francisco, CA / Seattle, WA / New York City, NY / Washington, DC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Safeguards team plays a critical role in ensuring our AI systems are deployed safely, responsibly, and in line with our values.

As an Incident Manager, you will manage Safeguards incidents involving our AI systems from declaration through closure. You will assess severity, bring in the right people from Legal, Communications, Policy, Threat Intelligence, Security, Engineering, and research teams, keep leadership informed, and see follow-up work through. You will also oversee the Safeguards Enforcement on-call queue on a rotating basis, and help build and scale the incident response program, including runbooks, post-incident reviews, and automation of routine work.

Important context for this role: in this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a violent, sexual, or psychologically disturbing nature. This role also includes after-hours and weekend incident coverage on a rotating basis.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as incident commander for Safeguards incidents from declaration through closure

  • Assess what qualifies as an incident, propose severity, and coordinate responders across Legal, Communications, Policy, Threat Intelligence, Security, Engineering, and research teams

  • Keep everyone working from the same facts by tracking input from each team, establishing what is known, what has changed, and what is still open, and sending regular updates that executives and partner teams rely on

  • Make sure Legal, Communications, and Public Policy are consulted before decisions that need them, and coordinate any external notifications

  • Run post-incident reviews, assign action items to named owners, and track them through closure

  • Oversee the on-call queue during your rotation as the first responder for urgent requests and escalations to Safeguards Enforcement

  • Triage each request, resolve what you can, route the rest to the owning team, and recognize when a request is the start of an incident

  • Take part in after-hours and weekend incident coverage on a rotating basis

  • Scope and deliver projects that improve the incident response program, such as on-call automation, incident readiness, and post-incident reviews and metrics

  • Draft and maintain runbooks and standard operating procedures

  • Work with Safeguards engineers to automate or reroute requests by writing the decision rules and testing the result

  • Maintain the incident record and the metrics that show leadership how the program is performing

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience running incidents or urgent escalations from start to finish in trust and safety, security, platform integrity, crisis management, or a comparable field, and readiness to lead high-severity incidents with support

  • Hands-on experience with incidents where someone was abusing or misusing a product or platform, such as account compromise, fraud, or coordinated malicious activity

  • Ability to make clear decisions under time pressure, record your reasoning, and recognize when a decision belongs to Legal, Policy, or leadership

  • Ability to write short, accurate updates that an executive can act on and that hold up to legal and external scrutiny

  • Experience coordinating people across many functions who do not report to you, securing their commitments, and following through on them

  • Experience improving an operational process on your own initiative, and the ability to tell which steps need a person and which can be automated

  • Willingness to do hands-on queue work as a regular part of the job, and to treat it as a source of information about what is breaking

  • Ability to participate in after-hours and weekend incident coverage on a rotating basis

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience joining an incident response function early and helping write runbooks and review processes

  • Experience with incidents involving AI systems

  • Experience with the enforcement steps that follow an incident, such as account actions, law enforcement referrals, or user and customer notifications

  • Experience working with threat intelligence or security investigation teams during an incident

  • Experience with regulatory or external incident reporting and disclosure

  • Experience running an on-call rotation or support escalation queue, including setting and measuring response targets

  • Experience using AI tools to automate triage, summaries, or routine decisions, with checks on quality

  • Working knowledge of SQL or similar tools for analyzing incident and queue data

  • Experience designing and facilitating tabletop exercises

  • Genuine interest in AI safety and responsible technology development

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$245,000—$285,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY / Washington, DC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Integrity and Authenticity Policy Manager, you will be responsible for developing, refining, and maintaining policies that prevent the misuse of AI systems for deception, manipulation, and unauthorized monitoring at scale. You will serve as the policy owner for risks related to inauthentic behavior, influence activity, surveillance, and the profiling of individuals and groups, and you will help shape policy frameworks across several areas, including authenticity, information integrity, and privacy and surveillance.

Your initial focus will be on translating the Integrity and Authenticity risk framework into clear, enforceable policies, ensuring policy language addresses emerging threats identified by partner teams, and establishing guidelines that enable consistent enforcement decisions. Many of the most serious harms in this space begin with upstream steps that look routine on their own, such as compiling records about a person, automating account creation, or sorting users by inferred identity. Part of your work will be defining where those steps become prohibited. The role will expand as AI capabilities advance. Safety is core to our mission. You will help ensure our products cannot be used to deceive people at scale, monitor and profile people without their knowledge or consent, or sort and target populations based on sensitive characteristics.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature, as well as detailed descriptions of privacy violations, surveillance abuses, and deceptive campaigns targeting vulnerable people.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and define policy boundaries for covert monitoring, tracking, and surveillance across different contexts, drawing the distinction between malicious behaviors and compliant dual-use scenarios

  • Write policy guidance on facial recognition, voice cloning, and geolocation inference, specifying which uses require consent and which are prohibited outright

  • Map the surveillance lifecycle, from target selection and data collection through analysis and covert deployment, and define the policy line at each stage so that interventions can occur early in the chain

  • Design and oversee evaluations that measure the model's capability to support social media monitoring, people-finding, predictive profiling, and the identification or tracking of specific people, to build, develop and improve safeguards with cross-functional partners to prevent malicious behaviors

  • Write and refine external-facing Usage Policy language and develop training guidelines, assessment rubrics, and evaluation protocols for enforcement teams, with emphasis on indicators of covert monitoring and population-level targeting

  • Validate enforcement decisions and automated assessments, provide policy guidance on complex edge cases such as investigative research into surveillance tools, coordinate with civil society, privacy experts, threat intelligence researchers, and academics, and serve as the escalation point for complex integrity and surveillance cases

Minimum qualifications

  • Working knowledge of how deceptive campaigns and covert monitoring operate in practice, including account networks, bot operations, data aggregation pipelines, and attribution methods

  • Familiarity with surveillance technologies and their misuse, including social media monitoring tools, people-search services, location tracking, spyware, facial recognition, and open-source intelligence techniques used against individuals

  • General knowledge of the global regulatory landscape around data protection, privacy, platform regulation, and digital services accountability

  • Strong policy writing skills, with the ability to translate complex threat frameworks into clear, enforceable guidelines

  • Experience designing policies and workflows that enable both clear human enforcement decision-making and technical implementation in ML classifiers and detection pipelines

  • Strong collaboration skills and extensive experience partnering with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Threat Intelligence, and Policy teams on cross-functional initiatives

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain deceptive tactics, surveillance methods, and policy rationales to diverse audiences, including non-specialists and policymakers

Preferred qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in policy development, trust and safety, threat intelligence, or platform integrity, with hands-on work on inauthentic behavior, surveillance-related abuse, or data misuse

  • Experience in privacy policy, privacy engineering, or data protection work, including familiarity with privacy impact assessments and data minimization principles

  • Experience in intelligence roles, state-aligned monitoring operations, or covert data collection campaigns

  • Experience investigating inauthentic networks, covert monitoring, or surveillance abuses at a platform, research organization, or government body

  • Background in digital forensics, open-source intelligence, or threat attribution

  • Knowledge of persuasion theory, cognitive biases, and deceptive communication techniques, including social engineering and pretexting methods

  • Familiarity with human rights and privacy frameworks as they apply to surveillance, including protections for journalists, activists, and marginalized communities

  • Experience with trust and safety operations involving content moderation evasion, bot detection, or platform scraping enforcement

  • Experience working with EU institutions, regulatory bodies, or policy organizations on AI governance or digital platform regulation

  • Experience conducting adversarial testing, red teaming, or vulnerability assessments for AI systems or platforms, particularly for misuse involving monitoring or profiling

  • Familiarity with generative AI capabilities and an understanding of how LLMs can be used for synthetic personas, social engineering, predictive profiling, or surveillance at scale

$245,000—$285,000 USD

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

About the Team

The People Strategy & Transformation (PST) is PointClickCare's HR strategy, organizational design, and portfolio management pillar. The team includes HR Business Partners, Organizational Design & Effectiveness, People Experience, and the HR Strategy & Enablement function, with a dotted-line partnership to Internal Communications. PST is responsible for ensuring HR's work across every Center of Excellence is planned, resourced, sequenced, and tracked against business outcomes — spanning a portfolio of Pillar Initiatives, Cross-Pillar Projects, and Program Roll-Ups delivered across all four HR solution groups.

Position Summary:

The Director, People Strategy and HR Portfolio (Project) Managements is the VP, People Strategy & Transformation's strategic thought partner in building and running PointClickCare's HR Portfolio Management Office (HR PMO) — co-designing the strategy, governance model, capacity methodology, and dashboard reporting that let HR plan, resource, and track its work against business outcomes. This is a net-new function: no HR PMO currently exists at PointClickCare, and this role will design these mechanics in partnership with the VP rather than operate a system someone else has already built.

Operating with significant design authority but without direct reports or final decision rights on cross-functional trade-offs, this role earns influence through the credibility of the mechanics it builds and runs. It operates across all four HR solution groups without formal authority over any of them, serves as the VP's thought partner on HR strategy and the HR SLT prioritization process, and convenes HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications to coordinate how HR's work reaches the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and run the HR Portfolio Management Office’s core operating mechanics

  • Design and maintain the capacity management methodology, including the heat map model and the oversubscription thresholds used to flag resourcing conflicts across HR COEs
  • Own and run the Portfolio Council governance cadence end to end — intake, capacity check, tier assignment, publish, mid-quarter check, and close-out
  • Build and maintain the integrated HR initiative dashboard, ensuring data currency and accuracy across every active Pillar Initiative, Cross-Pillar Project, and Program Roll-Up
  • Example deliverable: a quarterly Portfolio Council capacity heat map showing every HR COE’s current initiative load, used to approve or defer new initiative intake

Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, People Strategy & Transformation

  • Co-design the HR SLT prioritization process and criteria used to evaluate and sequence HR initiatives each planning cycle
  • Co-design the OKR and scorecard measurement architecture — what gets measured, how it rolls up, and the cadence it runs on
  • Co-author and stress-test the HR Strategy on a Page, contributing independent analysis before it is finalized by the VP
  • Example deliverable: a documented HR SLT prioritization framework — criteria, weighting, and process — adopted for the FY28 planning cycle

Own capacity management and project plan oversight across the full HR initiative portfolio

  • Track progress against committed business outcomes, not activity completion alone, across every active HR initiative
  • Maintain consistent project plan structure, milestone tracking, and dependency mapping in partnership with each initiative’s named Delivery Lead
  • Proactively surface cross-COE capacity collisions and resourcing conflicts before they reach Portfolio Council
  • Example deliverable: a consolidated project plan view across all active Program Roll-Ups, flagging dependency risk before it affects a committed milestone

Convene HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications on a recurring cadence

  • Establish and run a recurring go-to-market coordination cadence bringing together initiative Delivery Leads and Internal Communications
  • Sequence the timing and stakeholder readiness of HR initiative rollouts to the business, avoiding duplicate or conflicting messages landing in the same window
  • Maintain a shared go-to-market calendar visible to HR SLT, showing what is launching, when, and to whom
  • Example deliverable: a quarterly HR go-to-market calendar sequencing every planned initiative rollout to the business, reviewed and approved by HR SLT before the quarter begins

Represent HR in enterprise planning and governance forums

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison to the Strategic Delivery Office, aligning HR’s initiative classification and intake practices to enterprise taxonomy
  • Represent HR’s initiative portfolio and capacity picture in the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning cadence
  • Flag enterprise-level dependencies or conflicts affecting HR’s ability to deliver against committed priorities
  • Example deliverable: HR’s consolidated initiative and capacity submission into the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning sprint, reflecting current Portfolio Council status

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 10–15 years of experience in program/portfolio management, management consulting, or a PMO leadership capacity, including demonstrated experience designing — not only operating — portfolio governance, capacity management, or OKR measurement systems
  • A track record serving as a strategic thought partner to a senior leader, with evidence of shaping that leader's thinking rather than only executing direction
  • Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments without formal authority over the teams being coordinated
  • Strong data and dashboard fluency — comfortable architecting reporting tools and the metrics model behind them, not just maintaining an existing build
  • Executive-level communication skills — this role prepares materials for and interacts directly with VP-level stakeholders across every HR pillar
  • Experience convening cross-functional stakeholder groups to coordinate sequencing and alignment on complex, multi-team initiatives

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience building a PMO or governance function from scratch, in a design capacity, rather than operating within an already-mature one
  • HR domain experience, including familiarity with COE structures and business-outcome-linked workforce initiatives
  • Experience partnering with internal communications or marketing functions on coordinated, multi-stakeholder rollouts

title: Prototype Researcher
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, and Seattle.

We are looking for a Prototype Researcher to join Runway Labs — our research and exploration team pushing the frontier of AI video and General World Models. You’ll imagine, design, and build experimental experiences that make emerging AI capabilities tangible and communicate a compelling vision for where the technology is heading.

This role combines creative thinking, hands-on prototyping, and storytelling. You should be able to develop an original idea, build a working prototype, and shape it into a clear, memorable demonstration. Your work will help people understand new AI systems through experiences they can see, use, and engage with.

Working closely with researchers, engineers, and designers, you’ll explore new interfaces and interaction paradigms for AI-generated video, world models, and agentic systems. The focus is on research explorations that express our vision, reveal new possibilities, and strengthen Runway’s position as a full-stack research organization.

We’re looking for a motivated self-starter with strong creative judgment, technical fluency, and a portfolio that shows both what you can build and how well you can communicate an idea.

What you’ll do

  • Develop original concepts that explore the possibilities of emerging AI systems, from interactive video and world models to agentic experiences.

  • Design and build working prototypes that turn research capabilities into engaging, understandable experiences.

  • Shape each project’s story: what it explores, why it matters, and what it suggests about the future.

  • Package explorations into polished demos, films, and interactive experiences that communicate our research and vision.

  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers to understand new capabilities and identify compelling ways to demonstrate them.

  • Move quickly through experimentation, using prototypes to test ideas and refine both the experience and its narrative.

What you’ll need

  • A portfolio of original projects that demonstrates creative thinking, design craft, technical execution, and strong storytelling.

  • The ability to take an idea from an early concept to a working prototype and a compelling presentation.

  • Hands-on experience building interactive experiences with code, with the judgment to choose the right tools for each experiment.

  • Strong visual and interaction design skills, with an eye for detail and an instinct for making complex ideas accessible.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI video, world models, agentic systems, and emerging generative media.

  • Comfort working in ambiguous research environments, defining your own direction, and learning new tools as the work evolves.

  • The ability to explain the purpose and potential of your work clearly, through writing, visuals, demos, or film.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

title: Product Designer, Growth
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly.

We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly.

As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you.

We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible.

Key responsibilities

  • Own growth for how people use Claude in their everyday work, end to end, as your full-time focus
  • Diagnose what drives deep, habitual use and what blocks it, combining data, research, and hands-on time in the product
  • Set an opinionated vision for the area and turn it into a roadmap with your PM, engineering, and data science partners

description:

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a Vendor Admin Lead to own vendor master data for our global Finance Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Global Accounts Payable, you will be the single point of accountability for who our vendors are and get paid: onboarding, bank-detail verification, supporting documentation vetting, data quality and the controls around all of it. Anthropic's vendor base is growing quickly across the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific, and a clean, verified vendor data is what keeps a fast-growing company scale with the necessary controls.

This role is deliberately separate from invoice processing and payments. You will control vendor records and bank details; you will not book invoices or move money. That separation is the point of the role, and you will own the SOX controls that enforce it and help design the access model that keeps it that way.

This is an opportunity to build a vendor-master function from the ground up and leverage process automation with Claude while supporting the team making AI safe.

Responsibilities

Supplier onboarding

  • Run intake for every new vendor and payee: validate completeness, collect and verify supporting documentation, and enable records in the ERP backbone system against agreed service levels

  • Validate supporting documents; set 1099-reportable and tax flags correctly

  • Set up one-time and non-vendor payees with the right record type rather than forcing them through full onboarding

  • Partner with TPRM and IA teams on control requirements and continuous process improvement

  • 1099 annual reporting

Bank details and fraud prevention

  • Own every bank-detail setup and change; validate against a bank letter on letterhead or an approved equivalent (void checks, etc.)

  • Run independent callbacks per policy using contact details sourced independently of the request, and record the evidence

  • Validate international bank formats and addresses (IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, ABA, SEPA, BSB, IFSC, Japanese bank/branch codes)

  • Identify and escalate business-email-compromise attempts and other payment-fraud red flags

Data quality and maintenance

  • Lead vendor consolidation: eliminate duplicate vendors and bank accounts, execute merges and inactivations in batched, logged, reviewed changes

  • Run periodic health reviews for dormant vendors, stale bank letters, missing tax forms and incomplete records; drive 1099 and TIN readiness for year-end

  • Own periodic vendor deactivation campaigns

Controls and audit

  • Own the vendor-master SOX controls as the named control owner: maker-checker on every create and change, change-log review, evidence retained on every record

  • Prepare the periodic review of bank-detail changes paid, and address Internal Audit and external auditor requests

  • Partner with Finance Systems to design and maintain ERP security roles so vendor master, invoicing and payments stay separated

  • Flag any suspicious vendor set-up activity through the appropriate channels

Process, systems and improvement

  • Own vendor-master documentation, intake checklists, requester guidance and service levels

  • Serve as the vendor-data expert through process migrations, including data conversion and post-migration fixes

  • Partner on automation: AI-assisted intake validation, document extraction, bank-format checks and a vendor self-service portal

  • Report monthly on onboarding volume, cycle time, bank changes, exceptions and data quality, and use the data to improve the process

  • 7+ years in vendor master or AP operations with 3+ years of ownership

  • Owned a vendor master in an ERP end to end — process, controls and data — across multiple entities and countries

  • Hands-on experience verifying bank details and preventing payment fraud: bank letters, independent callbacks, BEC red flags, international bank formats

  • Experience with vendor tax documentation: W-9/W-8 validation, TIN matching, VAT/GST IDs, 1099 flagging

  • Working knowledge of procure-to-pay controls — segregation of duties, maker-checker, change logs, audit evidence — and have performed or owned a SOX control

  • Led a vendor data cleanup, consolidation or ERP migration and can show the outcome

  • The confidence to hold the line with requesters, vendors and senior stakeholders under time pressure while staying clear and helpful

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills with large datasets (dedupe, lookups, reconciliations) and exceptional attention to detail

Preferred qualifications

  • SOX experience at a public company or one preparing to go public

  • Experience supporting APAC and EMEA vendors in a high-growth, multi-entity company

title: Technical Accounting Lead, Ads Revenue
description:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Revenue team plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to scale commercial offerings by overseeing billing operations, deal desk, revenue systems, revenue accounting, and controllership. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Technical Accounting to support new monetization strategies, improve operational efficiency, and maintain financial integrity as the business grows.

About the Role

This senior leader will own key elements of Ads revenue accounting from technical assessment through operational execution. The role will guide accounting for products, pricing, contracts, incentives, credits, refunds, makegoods, international expansion, and new go-to-market motions. It will establish governance and translate approved accounting positions into launch, billing, data, close, reconciliation, and control requirements. Success requires deep technical revenue expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to build durable 0-to-1 processes in a fast-changing environment.

Advertising is a critical and growing monetization vector for OpenAI, and this role will help shape the financial foundations that enable Ads to scale responsibly and transparently.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical accounting assessments for Ads products and commercial arrangements, including performance obligations, variable consideration, allocation, principal-versus-agent, collectibility, contract modifications, refunds, incentives, credits, makegoods, and revenue presentation.

  • Own and continuously evolve Ads revenue accounting policies and operating guidance as product behavior, pricing, contracting, incentive programs, and billing models change.

  • Establish governance for new products and accounting decisions, including intake, decision rights, materiality and escalation thresholds, launch approvals, policy versioning, decision logs, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Translate accounting conclusions into clear requirements for product design, contracting, billing, data, estimates, close, reconciliations, controls, and reporting.

  • Own the operating cadence for incentive and makegood accounting, invoice readiness, accruals and reserves, settlements, reconciliations, GL tie-outs, flux analysis, reporting, and control evidence.

  • Partner with Ads Product, Engineering, Data, Finance Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Tax, Billing, and Technical Accounting on launches, enterprise negotiations, and international expansion.

  • Prepare concise technical memos and audit-ready support; align novel or material conclusions with Corporate Technical Accounting and external auditors.

  • Use data, AI, and automation to improve research, monitoring, policy maintenance, issue tracking, documentation, and repeatable Finance workflows with appropriate review controls.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, including direct ownership of complex ASC 606 judgments and operational execution.

  • Demonstrated leadership to independently set direction, prioritize across competing risks, and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Experience with digital advertising, adtech, marketplaces, payments, usage-based services, or another high-volume transaction environment.

  • Strong command of variable consideration, principal-versus-agent, contract modifications, incentives and credits, collectibility, estimates, and revenue presentation.

  • Track record building 0-to-1 accounting processes, governance, close mechanisms, reconciliations, and controls that scale.

  • Ability to turn technical conclusions into practical product, contract, billing, data, and operating requirements.

  • Clear, concise written and executive communication, including audit-ready documentation and evidence-based recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting global launches, multiple currencies, international contracting entities, intercompany considerations, or localized billing models.

  • Experience applying AI or automation within Finance while maintaining review, validation, and control standards.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, or Finance systems teams.

  • Experience developing or leading high-performing accounting teams or distributed operating groups.

  • Background in public-company controllership, technical accounting, audit, or similarly rigorous control environments.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
